title: Data Center Technician II
descriptionHtml:
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Belgium: €68000 - €69500 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Unpack, rack, wire, and bring new physical hardware, servers, and network equipment online.
  • Diagnose hardware issues as they happen by following clear procedures to figure out what’s broken and get the equipment back up and running.
  • Safely manage sensitive storage hardware; track, securely erase, old hardware in accordance with security standards to ensure data is not at risk.
  • Dismantle outdated equipment that has reached the end of its life, salvaging usable components and recycling the rest.
  • Perform routine checks and physical maintenance on servers, networking equipment, and infrastructure to prevent problems before they start.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems, computer hardware and server hardware.
  • Experience with the assembly of mechanical or electrical systems, or performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment.
  • Experience with networking protocols.
  • Ability to lift /move up to 23kg of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.
  • Must have the ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in maintenance and monitoring of server systems.
  • Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.
  • Experience with Linux operating systems.

title: Energy Initiatives Lead, LATAM
descriptionHtml:
Google's infrastructure needs go far beyond server computers. As Google's products and services scale the globe, the Strategic Negotiation team works behind the scenes to secure infrastructure for Google's future -- everything from underwater cables to physical data center space. As a Strategic Negotiator, you combine your deep market knowledge of a given sector with tech industry savvy to negotiate cost-effective solutions to support Google's infrastructure growth. You'll work with specific project teams on negotiating deals, managing vendor and partner relationships and presenting deal recommendations to our Tech leadership. Your successful negotiations have the potential to save Google millions of dollars in operating costs and impact every part of the business.

In this role, you will help Google solve customers’ business issues by providing global infrastructure and resource solutions. Within this broader mission, the ELS Energy team endeavors to help Google achieve it's goals of low-cost, clean, and reliable energy supply to its global fleet of data centers.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Lead evaluations of energy regulatory environments, wholesale market designs, and clean energy policy frameworks across key Latin American markets, monitoring power pricing dynamics, transmission planning, capacity mechanisms, and renewable integration rules to identify opportunities and mitigate risks for Google’s infrastructure footprint.
  • Develop and execute regional energy market development and energy regulatory engagement strategies, leading interventions before national energy ministries, regulatory agencies, system operators, and utility bodies to establish viable paths for clean energy procurement and grid access.
  • Lead regional stakeholder engagement and coalition-building, collaborating with industry associations, large energy consumers, renewable developers, and grid operators across goals Latin American jurisdictions to advocate for open, transparent, and engaged power market rules.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in negotiations or business development.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Deep working knowledge of power market structures, regulatory frameworks, and key energy stakeholders across Latin American wholesale electricity systems, including bilateral power contracting, merchant markets, transmission access, and clean energy policy.
  • Creative approach to solving complex, multi-stakeholder issues, with the ability to navigate ambiguous and rapidly evolving regulatory environments, executive presence, and excellent project management skills.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Spanish or Portuguese fluently to engage with local stakeholders.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated success securing energy regulatory, policy, or market outcomes within Latin American energy arenas.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
As a Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production-grade reality within customers. You will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. You will serve a dual purpose: providing white glove deployment of AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.
It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a developer for AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
  • Build evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
  • Be able to co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development using Python or related coding languages.
  • Experience taking production-grade AI solutions from conception to launch and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
  • Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
  • Experience managing technical discovery sessions.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 8 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.
  • Experience in customer-facing role, engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders
  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
  • Knowledge of Large Language Model (LLM) native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

title: Group Product Manager, Android and Wear Health Services
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

As a Group Product Manager, you will define and execute the core health, fitness, and continuous sensing strategy for Google’s wearable platform. You will lead the platformization of health APIs, sensor ingestion, exercise tracking infrastructure, and cross-device fitness continuity across Pixel Watch, Fitbit, third-party OEMs and emergent multi-device ecosystems (such as Android XR). You will serve as an Individual Contributor responsible for high-stakes platform architectures, complex partner relationships, and technical product definitions that power health features for millions of wrist-wearable users worldwide.

Platform teams push the boundaries of embedded systems, sensing accuracy, and low-power compute. You will bridge hardware constraints with high-level software abstractions, ensuring that our wearable ecosystem delivers exceptional health accuracy, low-power continuous tracking, and developer-friendly platform APIs.

Are you ready to shape the future of wearable technology and impact how millions of people experience wearables daily? Are you ready to empower developers building the apps that define this rapidly evolving device category? Help us with one of the most important challenges: designing for the most personal devices worn today by millions of users. The Wear OS team's mission is to effortlessly connect users with their health, loved ones, and the world around them, offering a seamless smartwatch experience with access to their favorite apps and services. We provide the core Android experience, tailored specifically for wearables. The age of wearable computing is upon us and Wear OS is at the forefront of creating a place for users, hardware manufacturers, and app developers to come together and help make lives simpler and more seamless.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $240000 - $333000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Own the multi-year Android Health Services & Wear Health Services (AHS/WHS) direction across first-party (Pixel Watch, Fitbit) and third-party (3P) Android ecosystems.
  • Lead end-to-end definition for health data types, granular permissions (e.g., Raw Health Sensors), and low-power exercise session tracking.
  • Partner on Hardware/Software (HW/SW) offloading—including continuous sensing, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE GATT) ingestion (power, HR, cadence), and Microcontroller Unit (MCU) display offload—to optimize battery life.
  • Collaborate with Gemini and XR teams on Universal Fitness Objects (UFO), AI coaching, and streaming to Augmented Reality (AR) glasses.
  • Direct strategic OEM partnerships, Early Access Programs, and developer outreach. Oversee accuracy benchmarking (Sense8) and privacy/security reviews with PCounsel and PWG.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
  • 5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Bioengineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience leading complex technical partnerships across Tier-1 OEMs, silicon vendors, and third-party developers (e.g., Strava).
  • Experience in low-power HW/SW co-design (MCU offloading, BLE GATT ingestion) and cross-device experience definition (watches, phones, AR/XR).
  • Knowledge in PPG algorithms, GNSS, HR, SpO2, HRV, and vitals monitoring.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Legal, and Privacy along with excellent storytelling skills.

title: Data Center Facilities Technician
descriptionHtml:

Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components).

You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

title: Software Engineer, Applied AI Agents, Professional Intelligence, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
At DeepMind our mission is to build the world's first general-purpose learning agent. Central to this mission is the complex task of measuring the intelligence of our prototypes. As a Software Engineer, you will be working with the AI agents developed by our exceptional team of Machine Learning and Neuroscience research scientists. Your responsibilities will include everything from creating systems for agent testing using 2D and 3D games to developing test problems within physics simulators. You will create graphical visualization of results, build competitive agent leaderboards and test new algorithms on robots. To succeed in this role you will need to have a strong foundation in software engineering and enjoy working on a wide range of challenging problems within a mission-driven team.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Act like an owner ask questions, propose solutions, build consensus, and drive execution from concept to delivery.
  • Build agent capabilities design and implement skills, plugins and typed tools for LLM agents that search, read, reason over and cite large private corporate.
  • Make outputs verifiable build grounding and citation checks, access-aware retrieval, and automated review of agent-authored knowledge, so every result can be audited back to its sources.
  • Lead evaluation build evaluation suites and datasets with subject matter experts, measure factual accuracy, citation fidelity and multi-step reasoning, and use the results to drive improvements.
  • Ship to production strong code quality, testing, CI/CD and monitoring for agent systems used daily by professionals.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in Python or TypeScript with modern toolchains and frameworks.
  • Experience building/shipping applications powered by LLMs: prompting, tool use or function calling, retrieval-augmented generation, and agent orchestration.
  • Experience designing evaluations for LLM or ML systems and using them to drive measurable quality improvements.
  • Experience owning production software end-to-end, from design and implementation to deployment, monitoring and iteration on user feedback.
  • Experience using coding agents to develop code and tests to specification.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with agent frameworks and protocols or agentic coding environments.
  • Experience with search and retrieval systems and citation or grounding verification.
  • Experience building products for legal, finance, compliance or other regulated, high-stakes domains, or working closely with domain experts.
  • Exposure to fine-tuning or reinforcement learning for LLMs, and experience on Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with agent safety, red teaming, and adversarial testing of autonomous AI systems.
  • Experience or research background in recursive self-improvement (RSI) architectures, automated self-correction, or self-evolving agent frameworks.

title: Network Implementation Engineer, Network Delivery Implementation
descriptionHtml:
As a Network Implementation Engineer, you will be the initial point of our efforts to execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide. You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.

You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $126000 - $180000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Work primarily in Council Bluffs with regional travel as needed based on New Product Introduction locations.
  • Oversee and provide Quality Assurance of installation technicians for rack, stack, and installation of networking equipment.
  • Commission and test routers, optical transport equipment, and other network devices in new and existing network nodes across Google's global network.
  • Generate implementation plans and provide technical leadership and guidance during deployment activities. Own network documentation, updating and maintaining network drawings and plan
  • Work with project management, network engineering, and the rest of the engineering team to identify in advance potential problems in network installations, including in the areas of facility power (Alternating Current / Direct Current), cooling, security/access, rack layout, and cable management.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience with network routing protocols or optical networks, design and troubleshooting, with network equipment providers.
  • 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (such as Go, Python, C++...), or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience identifying recurring errors in deployment packages or specifications and driving feedback loops to improve design accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Familiarity with network troubleshooting and testing tools.
  • Familiarity with network automation tools, scripting, or AI fluency to query databases and track deployment consistency.
  • Linux experience (e.g., run commands, move directories).

title: Innovation and Transformation Lead, Google Cloud (English, Japanese)
descriptionHtml:

We help customers transform and evolve their business through the use of Google’s global network, web-scale data centers, and software infrastructure. As part of an innovative team in this rapidly growing business, you will help shape the future of businesses of all sizes and use technology to connect with customers, employees, and partners.

The Google Cloud Consulting Professional Services team empowers organizations to digitally transform their businesses, leveraging the best infrastructure, platform, industry solutions, and expertise.

In this role, you will be a key partner, guiding customers through critical phases of their cloud journey and helping them succeed. You will lead innovation and transformation initiatives, leveraging the full potential of Google's technology and solutions. You will work directly with Google’s business customers, engaging with executive leaders, stakeholders, and practitioners to accelerate organizations business transformation with Google Cloud. You will manage, scale, and guide their immediate and long-term direction and results.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Preferred qualifications:

title: Technical Program Manager, Data Center Capacity Delivery
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

We are seeking an executive-level Technical Program Manager for Data Center Capacity Delivery to oversee hyperscale data center development programs from site selection through construction, commissioning, and operational handover.

In this role, you will lead multi-gigawatt, multi-billion-dollar infrastructure portfolios, drive dynamic delivery schedules, manage complex AI/ML technical insertions, and establish exceptional safety and operational standards across internal cross-functional teams and external contractor partners.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Direct the complete lifecycle of hyperscale data center builds, including entitlements, permitting, design, procurement, fast-track construction, commissioning, and operational handover.
  • Oversee multi-gigawatt capacity portfolios ($5B+ in contract value), maintaining full accountability for schedule, cost, quality, and risk management across active campuses.
  • Manage high-density compute capacity deployment, incorporating late-stage tech insertions for GPU and TPU infrastructure, high-density power systems, and advanced cooling technologies.
  • Align internal cross-functional partners alongside primary GC, EC, and MC contractors to ensure seamless capacity releases and program execution.
  • Establish site culture standards across large contractor workforces to maintain safety metrics and standardize regional delivery operating models.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in program management.
  • 8 years of experience in executive leadership delivering hyperscale data center capacity from greenfield builds to operational readiness.
  • 5 years of experience managing multi-hundred megawatt infrastructure delivery programs with portfolio values exceeding $1B.
  • 5 years of technical experience with high-density power delivery, substations, Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing/Fire Protection (MEP/FP)/Controls coordination, and fast-track design-build construction.
  • 5 years of experience in commercial management, including GMP contract negotiation, cost control, and general contractor supplier management.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or Business Administration (MBA).
  • 8 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
  • Experience managing liquid cooling, direct-to-chip, and late-stage hardware insertions for high-density GPU/TPU AI clusters.
  • Demonstrated expertise maintaining industry-leading safety standards (TRIR < 0.5) across large, multi-site contractor workforces.
  • Proven track record of driving sustainable construction initiatives and achieving low carbon footprint data center developments.
  • Proficiency with construction management tools such as Procore, MS Project, BIM 360, e-Builder, and enterprise procurement platforms.

title: Applied Solutions Architect, Data and AI
descriptionHtml:

title: Debug Partnerships Manager
descriptionHtml:
Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.

Debug (debug.com), a Google initiative to reduce mosquito-borne diseases, has spent over a decade developing end-to-end technologies to help protect the 4 billion people worldwide at risk of dengue. By integrating custom software, hardware automation, scientific innovation, and AI, Debug delivers both mosquito suppression and replacement solutions at scale. At the core of this approach is Wolbachia, a naturally occurring bacterium that serves as a precise, chemical-free way to stop mosquitoes from spreading diseases.

As the Partnerships Manager for India, you will be the entrepreneurial driver establishing Debug’s footprint from the ground up. You will navigate complex regulatory pathways, architect technology licensing partnerships, and bridge global engineering with local operational deployment to reduce mosquito-borne disease.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the agreement sourcing and execution including origination, evaluation, developing market strategies, and negotiating complex technology licensing agreements and commercial agreements with local operational partners, private enterprises, and public health entities.

title: Staff Research Software Engineer, Google Research
descriptionHtml:
Google Research Singapore is the very latest addition to the Google Research presence around the globe. This is an incredible opportunity to be advancing the frontier of AI capabilities in Singapore. The team delivers research on algorithmic efficiency, and inference acceleration, directly impacting how next-generation AI models will be deployed to billions of people.

In this role, you will sit at the heart of advancing fundamental capabilities of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to drive significant benefits to humanity. You will have the chance to help build a team from the ground up. You will be pioneering AI research in Singapore, focusing on enabling the most performant, ultra-efficient and capable Generative AI Models. You will be making pioneering breakthroughs towards Computational Efficiency for serving and deployment of large-scale Generative AI Models (e.g., Large Language Models (LLMs), Diffusion Models, Generative Videos).   • 5 years of experience with ML design and ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging, fine tuning).
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

title: Finance Subject Matter Expert, AI Models, Evaluations and Data, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
DeepMind is building frontier financial reasoning and agentic capabilities across Gemini and our enterprise agent harnesses. Moving AI from a generalist research assistant to an agent that can autonomously complete financial workflows requiresmore than raw pre-training scale - it requires deep domain mechanics embedded directly into how models are post-trained, how agent harnesses and tools are architected, and how evaluations measure real-world finance.

As a Finance Subject Matter Experts (SME), you will work with models, evaluations, and post-training data in the following three Finance domains -

  • Quantitative Trading
  • Corporate Finance - specifically with experience across FP&A, Audit and Tax
  • Alternative Asset Management

Unlike traditional advisory roles that stop at high-level feedback or static prompt writing, you will sit directly in the model development loop alongside Research Scientists, Post-Training Engineers, and Product Managers. You will prioritize differentiated financial workflows, design end-to-end financial benchmarks, construct atomic and deterministic grading rubrics, diagnose multi-step agent trajectories, repair near-miss model reasoning traces, design verifiable reward signals, and co-build domain-specific agent skills.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.


We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate the AI's step-by-step process across calculations, ledger searches, and code to pinpoint quantitative or accounting errors.
  • Create realistic financial tasks (e.g., valuations, backtests, audits) and write "gold-standard" examples to correct model near-misses.
  • Build complex prompts featuring vague instructions, GAAP/non-GAAP differences, and conflicting estimates to test AI resilience.
  • Create pass/fail checklists for deliverables and draft deceptive, polished-but-wrong answers to stress-test automated graders.
  • Teach the AI to efficiently use core financial tools (SQL, etc) and categorize error patterns into reusable templates.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 5 years of institutional finance experience in investigative, modeling-intensive roles (Quantitative Trading, Corporate Finance, or Alternative Asset Management).
  • Experience with frontier LLMs, coding agents, or AI evaluation pipelines, including structured prompts and tool-use traces.
  • Experience identifying flaws in AI-generated financial models, backtests, or memos, and translating these errors into generalizable grading rules.

Preferred qualifications:

  • CFA, CPA, MBA, JD, Master of Financial Engineering (MFE), or an advanced quantitative degree in Finance, Computer Science, Math, or Economics.
  • Background building benchmarks, rubrics, or SFT/RLHF pipelines at AI labs, fintechs, or quantitative teams.
  • Domain-specific excellence in Python and SQL (Quant) or advanced, macro-free spreadsheet software and Python/SQL (Alternative Asset Management/Corporate Finance).
  • Familiarity with market data feeds, SEC EDGAR, Capital IQ, FactSet, Bloomberg, ERP/EPM, and tax/audit platforms.

You will be a key contributor as a member of the Global Network Delivery team, directly impacting Google's ability to deliver network capacity to its customers. Your role offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of network delivery through automation and process innovation. Teamwork, collaboration, strong communication skills, and a proactive approach to challenging the status quo are essential for success in this role.Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life-cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning. title: Senior Product Manager, Eval Quality, AI Data
descriptionHtml:
Artificial Intelligence is evolving at an unprecedented pace, and AI Agents represent the next frontier. These agents, capable of complex reasoning, tool use, and interacting with dynamic environments, are poised to redefine how we live and work. Ensuring these agents are safe, reliable, and effective is paramount, and that's where evaluations come in.

Evaluations have always been the bedrock of successful AI development. However, the methods used for traditional Large Language Models fall short when it comes to agents. Unlike static models, agents operate in a world of vast possibilities, delivering value through a sequence of actions and interactions.

We need to pioneer new ways of thinking for agent evaluation. Think Waymo online: we must create rich, dynamic simulation environments to test agents against a massive state space, uncovering failure modes and ensuring robust performance across countless scenarios. This isn't just an incremental improvement; it's about defining how the next generation of AI will be validated.

If you're passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI and solving some of the most problems in the field, this is your chance. Come join our Evals team, where with products like Everest and EvalHub, we empower GenAI model development across Google. In this role, you will lead the product goal for how Google evaluates AI Agents, ensuring we build the most capable and trustworthy agentic systems in the world.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a first-principles understanding of what makes an evaluation task truly useful—optimizing for coverage, climbability (scaling with compute and data while preserving headroom), discriminability, statistical stability (tight confidence intervals), and zero contamination.
  • Synthesize insights into a holistic product goal and roadmap for Eval Quality.
  • Operate seamlessly across Product Area boundaries between Gemini, AI2, and other partner product areas.
  • Grow in Gemini’s dynamic, fast-moving, research-driven environment where priorities evolve rapidly and Product Managers earn trust by directly contributing to day-to-day execution.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in a product management, engineering, and technology strategy role.
  • 5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with LLM/GenAI evaluations, post-training/mid-training RL/SFT workflows, autoraters, or human-in-the-loop (HiTL) expert data collection.
  • Deep intuition for evaluation science—understanding what separates a brittle benchmark from a high-signal, climbable, uncontaminated evaluation across specialized verticals (e.g., finance, law, medicine, math, science, and engineering).
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the gravitas to align Executive Team Leads, Research Scientists, and VP/SVP leadership across London and US time zones.
  • Demonstrated track record of growing across Product Area boundaries specifically balancing the changing, execution culture of research organization.

title: Staff Research Data Scientist, Manager, Ads Metrics
descriptionHtml:

Minimum qualifications:

We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Architect and code the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
  • Design and deploy production-grade agentic developer workflows on Google Cloud's AI stack, executing large-scale refactors, language migrations, spec-to-PR pipelines, and automated review/incident-to-fix loops.
  • Embed with customers' Staff Engineers and Leaders to identify core SDLC bottlenecks, such as legacy migrations, test coverage, review latency, or onboarding friction, and define rigorous success metrics.
  • Integrate Google’s agentic systems into the customer's existing ISV and tools (e.g., Atlassian Rovo/Teamwork Graph, GitLab, ServiceNow, Slack) leveraging MCP and A2A protocols.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in cloud computing or a technical customer-facing role.
  • Experience deploying, scaling, and debugging Large Language Model (LLM) or agent-based systems in production environments (including tools, memory, orchestration, evaluation, tracing, and cost/latency profiling).
  • Experience with end-to-end technical ownership of engineering projects with executive stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
  • Experience with agentic frameworks and harness layers, such as Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) or equivalent, protocol-level interoperability (MCP, A2A) across third-party ISV platforms (e.g., Atlassian, ServiceNow), and security ecosystem in DevSecOps.
  • Knowledge of "LLM-native" metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

title: Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, Ngành Trò chơi và Ứng dụng, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (tiếng Anh, tiếng Việt)
locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để tăng trưởng trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn lan toả niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng đạt được thành công lớn nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google và khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, thấu hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và chuyển hoá những nhu cầu đó thành các giải pháp hiệu quả, giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu tham vọng nhất. Bạn phối hợp chặt chẽ với đội ngũ bán hàng để cùng gặt hái thành công, góp phần định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo ra những tác động thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Với vai trò là Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược cho ngành Trò chơi và Ứng dụng tại Việt Nam, bạn sẽ là đối tác chiến lược và cố vấn đáng tin cậy cho các nhà phát triển trò chơi và ứng dụng hàng đầu tại Việt Nam, giúp họ mở rộng quy mô và gặt hái thành công trên phạm vi toàn cầu. Bạn sẽ quản lý và thắt chặt các mối quan hệ ở cấp điều hành, định hình cách Google hỗ trợ hệ sinh thái tăng trưởng mạnh mẽ này trên toàn cầu.

Nhiệm vụ cốt lõi của bạn là bứt phá tăng trưởng kinh doanh cho khách hàng bằng cách tận dụng Chiến dịch quảng cáo ứng dụng của Google, hệ sinh thái ứng dụng trên khắp các dòng sản phẩm (bao gồm cả Google Play và các giải pháp Sellside), đồng thời khai thác các cơ hội đổi mới giữa các sản phẩm để mang lại kết quả kinh doanh vượt trội và có thể đo lường.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách chào bán một cách cạnh tranh trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google trên Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên trong nhóm LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh ở vị trí tiên phong của công nghệ, làm việc với ban điều hành, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả rõ rệt, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Hợp tác và tư vấn cho các khách hàng tại Việt Nam với mục tiêu cùng phát triển chiến lược kỹ thuật số, tăng cường kiến thức và mức độ sử dụng sản phẩm, nâng cao hiệu quả quảng cáo của khách hàng và phát triển hoạt động kinh doanh.
  • Xây dựng kế hoạch kinh doanh chung cho các tài khoản khách hàng quan trọng và giúp tạo bước ngoặt tăng trưởng thông qua việc thấu hiểu về mục tiêu kinh doanh, chỉ báo hiệu suất chính và các vấn đề.
  • Phân tích xu hướng dữ liệu và hiệu suất của khách hàng để đưa ra thông tin chuyên sâu về ngành, phối hợp với các phòng ban liên ngành để xác định những hướng đi chiến lược tiếp theo, đồng thời chuẩn bị và thực hiện các bài thuyết trình và chào hàng mang tính bứt phá.
  • Xây dựng nghiên cứu điển hình về các chiến dịch để chia sẻ thông tin chuyên sâu với khách hàng, cũng như để tham gia các sự kiện và hội nghị chuyên ngành.
  • Phát triển và duy trì các mối quan hệ với đội ngũ quản lý cấp cao, đóng vai trò là một đầu mối liên hệ với khách hàng và tư vấn về các xu hướng kỹ thuật số.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 8 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực quảng cáo kỹ thuật số, tư vấn bán hàng, phát triển kinh doanh hoặc tiếp thị kỹ thuật số.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp thông thạo bằng cả tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để phục vụ khách hàng nói tiếng Việt.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Có kinh nghiệm làm việc trong ngành trò chơi/ứng dụng, truyền thông, phát triển kinh doanh, tiếp thị hoặc tư vấn bán hàng.
  • Có kinh nghiệm và đạt được thành công trong việc phát triển và duy trì những khách hàng được quản lý có giá trị cao, phức tạp theo hướng chiến lược thông qua phương pháp tư vấn.
  • Kiến thức về các sản phẩm quảng cáo của Google trên Ứng dụng, Video, Mạng Hiển thị và Tìm kiếm.
  • Có khả năng vận dụng những cách tiếp cận sáng tạo để phát triển giải pháp qua dữ liệu.
  • Có kỹ năng tổ chức, giải quyết vấn đề, tạo sự ảnh hưởng và thuyết trình xuất sắc.

title: SoC and IP Design Engineer, Networking
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

In this role, you will join an IP and subsystem design team building foundational custom silicon for Google Cloud, rather than focusing solely on standalone block coding or chip-level assembly, blends Register-Transfer Level (RTL) micro-architecture with complex IP and subsystem integration. You will architect and implement custom wrappers, bridges, protocol adapters, and control, interrupt, and debug infrastructure to integrate third-party vendor IPs and internal blocks such as high-speed Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe) subsystems into cohesive, production-ready designs.

You will help modernize how we build silicon beyond RTL development, create and refine scripting and design automation flows that streamline large-scale IP assembly, configuration, and sign-off, while actively adopting and shaping advanced AI-powered and agentic workflows across hardware design, integration, and debug. You will partner closely with architecture, verification, physical implementation, Design for Test (DFT), software, and external IP vendors, you will drive Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) trade-offs from initial specification through silicon bring-up.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next-generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Define IP and subsystem micro-architecture specifications, including interface protocols, block diagrams, clocking and reset schemes, register maps, and transaction flows.
  • Integrate complex third-party vendor IPs and internal blocks (such as PCIe subsystems), developing custom SystemVerilog RTL wrappers, glue logic, and protocol adapters.
  • Execute RTL quality sign-off and debug across functional and performance simulation, Lint, Clock Domain Crossing (CDC), Reset Domain Crossing (RDC), Formal Verification, and Unified Power Format (UPF) checks.
  • Build and enhance design automation, RTL assembly tooling, and AI-assisted hardware engineering workflows to accelerate integration velocity and design quality.
  • Collaborate with architecture, verification, physical design, DFT, firmware, and external IP vendors on synthesis, timing and power (PPA) closure, coverage analysis, and ASIC silicon bring-up.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in digital logic design and RTL development using Verilog or SystemVerilog.
  • Experience with IP integration, subsystem design, or System-on-Chip (SoC) architecture.
  • Experience with logic synthesis, timing closure, and low-power design techniques.
  • Experience with RTL quality and sign-off tools (e.g., Lint, CDC).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience integrating third-party vendor IPs (such as controllers and PHYs), owning RTL wrappers, timing constraints, UPF, DFT handoffs, and vendor deliverables.
  • Experience with PCIe architecture and subsystem integration, or related interconnects and protocols such as Compute Express Link (CXL), Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express (UCIe), or Advanced Extensible Interface (AXI).
  • Experience developing scripts, RTL assembly automation, and Electronic Design Automation (EDA) flows (e.g., Python, Tcl).
  • Demonstrated eagerness to adopt and pioneer AI-driven tools and workflows across hardware design, integration, and debug.

title: Policy Lead, Global Policy and Standards, Monetization
descriptionHtml:
Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

This role is on the Monetized product policy team, a part of the Trust and Safety, Global Policy and Standards team. The role focuses on policy development for Google’s ads policies that address scams & deceptive marketing.

As a Product Policy Specialist, you will advise internal Google teams on core principles, design policies and standards to address abuse risks, and enable responsible growth. In addition, you will engage with subject matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders across Google to design thoughtful cross-prodcut area approaches on key priorities. As an independent, critical thinker, you will bring the investigative excellence to translate intricate problems into scalable solutions at defining precise standards for evolving areas of tech policy. You will balance the legal and regulatory requirements we face around the world with the needs of users, advertisers, creators and publishers, while upholding the company’s core values.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $164000 - $239000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Anticipate policy issues facing product and technology platforms and develop policies and enforcement recommendations on how to address them.
  • Lead, develop, and implement policies for Google products, with a view towards user safety and product quality.
  • Influence product decisions and prioritization and improve user experience for policy-related issues through collaboration with Product Managers, Engineers, and other Trust and Safety teams.
  • Drive awareness and understanding of our product policies within Google and across our user base through research to set industry standards.
  • Be exposed to graphic, controversial, or upsetting content.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in a policy, legal, Trust and Safety, or technology environment.

title: Software Engineer III, Site Reliability Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is what you get when you treat operations as if it’s a software problem. Our mission is to progress, protect, and provide for the software and systems behind all of Google’s public services - Search, Ads, Gmail, Android, YouTube, and AppEngine, to name just a few - with an ever-watchful eye on their availability, latency, performance, and capacity.

This is an unusual job, unlike others in the industry. Like traditional operations groups, we keep important, revenue-critical systems up and running despite hurricanes, bandwidth outages, and configuration problems. Unlike traditional operations groups, we also have full access to and authority to fix, extend, and scale the code to keep it working and harden it against all the vagaries of the Internet. We hire people from both systems and software backgrounds. Strong candidates will have experience with both.

Just as what we do is unique, where we do it is unique too. At Google, we have the good fortune to have developed many interesting systems ranging from planet-spanning databases to near real-time scalable data warehousing to fault-tolerant datastream joining. In SRE, we flip between the fine-grained detail of disk driver I/O scheduling to the big picture of continental-level service capacity, across a range of systems and a user population measured in billions. We own those products in production. We drive reliability and performance across massive scale by mastering the full depth of the stack. We literally do learn something new every day - usually surprising things - that have the potential to transform the lives of billions of our users around the world.
