title: Chuyên viên thương mại, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược, Đông Nam Á
locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
descriptionHtml:
Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google tại Đông Nam Á (SEA) tiếp sức cho các doanh nghiệp hàng đầu nâng cao doanh thu kỹ thuật số trong bối cảnh thương mại ưu tiên AI. Khi hành trình mua sắm kỹ thuật số phát triển trên khắp các sàn thương mại điện tử, cửa hàng trực tuyến của thương hiệu và mạng lưới nhà xuất bản bên ngoài sàn thương mại, nhóm của chúng tôi giúp các thương hiệu lớn trong lĩnh vực bán lẻ, hàng tiêu dùng đóng gói sẵn (CPG), công nghệ và bán hàng trực tiếp đến người tiêu dùng (D2C) nắm bắt nhu cầu của những khách hàng có ý định cao và tối đa hoá lợi tức đầu tư trực tuyến.

Nhóm Chuyên viên sản phẩm tập trung vào việc mang lại kết quả có thể đo lường và tối đa hoá lợi tức đầu tư cho khách hàng trên toàn bộ phễu tiếp thị bằng các giải pháp về đo lường, hiệu suất và quảng cáo thương hiệu.

Là một Chuyên viên thương mại, bạn sẽ đóng vai trò như một chuyên gia chuyên trách về thương mại và chuyên môn sâu cho lĩnh vực thương mại trực tuyến và mạng lưới truyền thông thương mại (CMN) ở khắp Đông Nam Á. Bạn sẽ hợp tác với các nhà quảng cáo thương hiệu hàng đầu, nhà bán lẻ trực tuyến thuần tuý và nhà điều hành mạng lưới truyền thông để đẩy nhanh việc áp dụng công nghệ quảng cáo thương mại tiên tiến, cơ sở hạ tầng dữ liệu sản phẩm và các giải pháp kiếm tiền từ đối tượng bên ngoài sàn thương mại. Bạn sẽ chẩn đoán phễu chuyển đổi trực tuyến, thúc đẩy tốc độ giao dịch trên web/ứng dụng và sàn thương mại điện tử, đồng thời xúc tiến các mục tiêu kinh doanh quan trọng cho đối tác của chúng tôi bằng các giải pháp của Google.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách chào bán một cách cạnh tranh trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google trên Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên trong nhóm LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh ở vị trí tiên phong của công nghệ, làm việc với ban điều hành, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả rõ rệt, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Thúc đẩy các chiến lược thương mại trên các mạng lưới truyền thông thương mại, chiến dịch Tìm kiếm, Tạo nhu cầu và Tối đa hoá hiệu suất để đạt được các mục tiêu về GMV, ROAS và tỷ lệ thu nạp của khách hàng trên khắp Đông Nam Á.
  • Hợp tác với các nhà bán lẻ kỹ thuật số và sàn thương mại điện tử hàng đầu để thiết kế, mở rộng quy mô và tạo ra cơ hội kinh doanh từ các giải pháp truyền thông thương mại bên ngoài sàn thương mại bằng cơ sở hạ tầng quảng cáo và tín hiệu về đối tượng của Google.
  • Đẩy nhanh việc áp dụng các công cụ thương mại dựa trên AI của Google và hướng dẫn nhà quảng cáo về việc đặt giá thầu nâng cao, tích hợp dữ liệu của bên thứ nhất và cấu trúc chiến dịch toàn phễu.
  • Xây dựng kế hoạch kinh doanh chung, cẩm nang và khung thuyết trình để nâng cao kỹ năng cho các nhóm quản lý tài khoản của LCS và công ty quảng cáo về việc tạo ra cơ hội kinh doanh thương mại và mở rộng quy mô hiệu suất.
  • Đóng vai trò một chuyên gia có chuyên môn sâu ở khu vực về lĩnh vực truyền thông bán lẻ kỹ thuật số, tổng hợp các xu hướng thị trường ở Đông Nam Á để cung cấp thông tin và tác động đến lộ trình sản phẩm toàn cầu.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực mạng truyền thông bán lẻ (RMN/CMN), quảng cáo thương mại kỹ thuật số, thương mại video hoặc tiếp thị dựa trên hiệu suất trong một nền tảng thương mại điện tử hoặc hệ sinh thái công nghệ.
  • Kinh nghiệm lập kế hoạch truyền thông kỹ thuật số cho các thương hiệu hàng tiêu dùng đóng gói sẵn (CPG), sàn thương mại điện tử trực tuyến hoặc nhà bán hàng thương mại điện tử thuần tuý.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Kinh nghiệm thực tiễn về video có thể mua sắm, thương mại qua hình thức phát trực tiếp và hệ sinh thái thương mại trên mạng xã hội, thúc đẩy hành trình từ khám phá đến thanh toán trên toàn phễu.
  • Thành tích đã được chứng minh trong việc mở rộng quy mô các giải pháp quảng cáo thương mại trực tuyến, bao gồm cả quảng cáo được tài trợ trên sàn thương mại, mạng lưới truyền thông thương mại (CMN) bên ngoài sàn thương mại hoặc các chương trình tạo ra hoạt động kinh doanh trên sàn thương mại điện tử.
  • Kỹ năng giao tiếp và quản lý nhân sự xuất sắc, cùng khả năng tác động đến các bên liên quan ở mọi cấp bậc.
  • Kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết vấn đề tốt, có khả năng rút ra thông tin chi tiết hữu ích từ dữ liệu.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp thông thạo bằng cả tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để trao đổi với các bên liên quan trong hoạt động kinh doanh.

title: Data Center Facilities Technician
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components).

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $105000 - $145000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components. 
  • Provide daily assistance to technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems, and assess their working order.
  • Manage the uptime and maintenance of water pumps and treatment systems, HVAC, UPS, generators, electrical distribution, and control and monitoring systems.

  • Support startup, commissioning, and integration of new equipment and systems into facilities infrastructure.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Generative AI, Google Cloud (Spanish, English)
descriptionHtml:

You will manage a team of skilled Policy Leads working on content moderation challenges facing YouTube today. Your team will focus on Adversarial Abuse Policy Development, operating on the front lines of platform defense. In this role, you will act as the critical bridge between behavioral threat analysis, machine learning engineering, operations, and product strategy.

This role will sometimes involve reviewing graphic, controversial, or offensive video content in line with YouTube’s Community Guidelines and our policies for the YouTube Partner Program.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. title: Quản lý phát triển đối tác chiến lược, Quan hệ đối tác hệ sinh thái Android
descriptionHtml:
Google luôn nỗ lực phát triển các dòng sản phẩm và dịch vụ của mình cho khách hàng. Nhóm Phát triển quan hệ đối tác chịu trách nhiệm tìm kiếm và khám phá cơ hội mới với các đối tác của Google. Với sự nhạy bén trong kinh doanh và kiến thức sâu rộng về sản phẩm, bạn sẽ là người trực tiếp làm việc với các đối tác của chúng tôi, giúp họ tìm ra cách tăng trưởng thông qua các dịch vụ và sản phẩm mới nhất của Google. Kiến thức của bạn về những ngành dọc có liên quan và mối quan hệ với các bên chủ chốt trong ngành sẽ góp phần định hình các ứng dụng và nội dung chất lượng cao của chúng tôi cho các sản phẩm như YouTube, Google TV và Commerce.

Với vai trò là Quản lý phát triển quan hệ đối tác chiến lược, bạn sẽ đi đầu trong việc thúc đẩy tăng trưởng cho Android cũng như các dòng sản phẩm nền tảng và thiết bị trong lĩnh vực viễn thông, nhà sản xuất thiết bị gốc (OEM) và bán lẻ. Bạn sẽ chịu trách nhiệm thiết kế các chiến lược hợp tác và thực hiện các thoả thuận phức tạp, đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc thúc đẩy nỗ lực thu nạp người dùng và phát triển kinh doanh của chúng tôi trong khu vực cùng với các đối tác. Là thành viên của nhóm Phát triển kinh doanh Android tại Châu Á – Thái Bình Dương, bạn sẽ phối hợp chặt chẽ với các nhóm Sản phẩm, Kỹ thuật, Tiếp thị và Pháp lý của Android về các sáng kiến mới và các mối quan hệ chiến lược quan trọng. Trong vai trò này, bạn sẽ xác định các xu hướng trong ngành và những người có tầm ảnh hưởng lớn, đồng thời quản lý quy trình từ đầu đến cuối.

Android là hệ điều hành di động của Google, hỗ trợ hơn 3 tỷ thiết bị trên toàn thế giới. Android mang sức mạnh điện toán đến cho mọi người trên thế giới. Chúng tôi tin rằng điện toán là một nguồn sức mạnh to lớn mang lại những giá trị tốt đẹp, tạo điều kiện tiếp cận thông tin, cơ hội kinh tế, nâng cao năng suất, kết nối giữa bạn bè và gia đình và nhiều lợi ích khác. Chúng tôi cho rằng mọi người trên thế giới đều có quyền tiếp cận những lợi ích tốt nhất mà công nghệ điện toán mang lại. Chúng tôi cung cấp nền tảng cho các nhà sản xuất thiết bị gốc (OEM) và nhà phát triển để xây dựng các thiết bị điện toán hấp dẫn (điện thoại thông minh, máy tính bảng, TV, thiết bị đeo, v.v.) chạy các ứng dụng/dịch vụ tốt nhất cho mọi người trên thế giới.

Responsibilities

  • Xác định và theo đuổi các cơ hội hợp tác mới để phát triển và tạo ra hoạt động kinh doanh cho hệ sinh thái Android, phù hợp với các mục tiêu chiến lược của Google về nền tảng và thiết bị.
  • Thu thập, tổng hợp và chia sẻ ý kiến phản hồi thực tiễn của đối tác trong nước cũng như các xu hướng của thị trường/quốc gia để thúc đẩy hiệu suất của toàn bộ Android cũng như Nền tảng và Thiết bị (P&D), đồng thời hợp tác với các phòng ban liên ngành để giải quyết và giảm thiểu các thách thức trong nước.
  • Nâng cao hiệu quả hoạt động trong mọi khía cạnh của mối quan hệ đối tác, thường xuyên đánh giá hoạt động kinh doanh, tích hợp thoả thuận, quản lý các vấn đề được chuyển lên cấp trên, v.v. Đóng vai trò là cầu nối chính để tiếp nhận ý kiến phản hồi và hiểu biết sâu sắc của đối tác.
  • Dẫn dắt các sáng kiến kinh doanh phức tạp, liên ngành từ khâu lên ý tưởng đến khi ra mắt, đảm bảo các sáng kiến này được triển khai đúng hạn và đạt tiêu chuẩn cao.
  • Chỉ đạo việc thống nhất các tiến độ, mục đích và mục tiêu của nhóm nội bộ. Hợp tác với các nhóm Sản phẩm, Kỹ thuật, Pháp lý, Tiếp thị và các nhóm khác để thực hiện chiến lược tổng thể về Nền tảng và Thiết bị.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 7 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực phát triển kinh doanh, quan hệ đối tác, tư vấn quản lý hoặc ngân hàng đầu tư.
  • 7 năm kinh nghiệm trong ngành nhà mạng di động/nhà sản xuất thiết bị gốc (OEM).
  • Kinh nghiệm làm việc với quản lý cấp cao và các phòng ban liên ngành ở mọi cấp quản lý.
  • Kinh nghiệm quản lý các thoả thuận hoặc quan hệ đối tác.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Khả năng giao tiếp lưu loát bằng cả tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để điều phối và hỗ trợ các mối quan hệ đối tác trong nước ở các thị trường Đông Nam Á (SEA).
  • Kinh nghiệm làm việc tại thị trường Việt Nam và Pakistan.
  • Kinh nghiệm làm việc độc lập trong một môi trường năng động, không ngừng thay đổi và giàu tính hợp tác.
  • Kinh nghiệm quản lý các mối quan hệ đối tác phức tạp từ đầu đến cuối.
  • Khả năng xác định các cơ hội kinh doanh tiềm năng, đánh giá lợi ích tài chính/kinh doanh, xây dựng thoả thuận và thảo luận các điều khoản với đối tác chiến lược.

title: Mechanical Technician (Technicien de maintenance)
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components).

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for the data centers.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Belgium: €78000 - €79500 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems such as piping and mechanical system components.
  • Provide daily assistance to technicians as you read blueprints/schematics/sequence of operations, conduct tours of systems, and assess their working order.
  • Manage the uptime and maintenance of water pumps and treatment systems, Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) and control, and monitor systems.
  • Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions in the data center facilities systems and equipment.
  • Support startup, commissioning, and integration of new mechanical equipment and systems into facilities infrastructure.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in mechanical or HVAC within an industrial or commercial environment.
  • Ability to participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying or moving up to 50 lbs (23 kg) of equipment, the required use of safety equipment such as limited weight bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools and personal protective equipment (PPE) like safety harnesses in accordance with safety and ergonomic guidelines and assessments.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours and work rotations/shifts.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience in maintenance of mechanical/cooling distribution systems or construction/technical environment or in a related field.
  • Experience in data centers, hospitals, or power plants.
  • Knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment.
  • Knowledge of mechanical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., chillers, air handling units, pumps and CRAC/CRAH units).
  • Ability to communicate with contractors who perform maintenance or upgrade work on the data center systems.

title: Product and Business Operations Manager, Trust and Safety, Google Play
descriptionHtml:
Google's Trust & Safety team is tasked with identifying and solving the biggest threats to the safety and integrity of our products, with a primary focus on the Google Play store ecosystem. We leverage technical know-how, sharp problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and partners from abuse across Google Play.

As authoritative workflow owners, the Content Strategy team serves as "0-to-1" design architects and content policy experts, building the structural frameworks that scale our operational capabilities. Day-to-day, team members own the operational reality of content policies by acting as subject matter experts, managing complex escalations, conducting targeted sweeps, and driving continuous process and detection improvements. To support rapid ecosystem growth, the team also leads the messy, early-stage work of incubation—designing the foundational playbooks, training, and operational frameworks required to scale new safety systems effectively. Our deep expertise in content policy is the engine that fuels this design.

On this team, you are a big-picture thinker with the judgment and decision-making instinct to navigate ambiguity— and execute from "0 to 1". You are a team player who thrives in cross-functional spaces, seamlessly partnering globally with engineers, product managers, policy, and operations to identify and fight abuse cases with urgency. Ultimately, you take pride in knowing your work directly promotes trust in Google and ensures the highest levels of user safety.

Please note that this role involves regular exposure to sensitive platform content, including graphic violence, harm, and Non-Consensual Intimate Imagery (NCII), etc.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the definitive subject matter expert on Google Play workflows and complex policy enforcement, conducting root cause analyses on ambiguous edge cases.
  • Monitor operational metrics across the Google Play ecosystem, identify opportunities for optimization, and collaborate cross-functionally to drive resolution.
  • Lead early-stage incubation and piloting for new Google Play safety systems, writing playbooks and training materials to scale them effectively.
  • Pivot to absorb novel app-level threats within the Google Play store, identify upstream detection gaps, and lead high-pressure escalations to resolve critical abuse vectors.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Ops teams to embed automation readiness into safety models and manage feedback loops to improve tool accuracy.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in data analytics, Trust & Safety, policy, cybersecurity, or related fields.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Ability to manage messy, early-stage "0-to-1" incubation phases across complex workflow design and policy strategy.
  • Ability to maintain a resilient, can-do attitude to serve as a rapid-response layer for unforeseen platform crises and high-risk vectors.
  • Ability to exercise high ownership in governing urgent, sensitive platform tracks and resolving complex, ambiguous policy escalations.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and communication across technical and non-technical teams (Engineering, Product, Policy).
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail in an ever-changing environment.

title: Strategic Negotiator, Data Center Site Acquisition, Energy and Location Strategy
descriptionHtml:
Google's infrastructure needs go far beyond server computers. As Google's products and services scale the globe, the Strategic Negotiation team works behind the scenes to secure infrastructure for Google's future -- everything from underwater cables to physical data center space. As a Strategic Negotiator, you combine your deep market knowledge of a given sector with tech industry savvy to negotiate cost-effective solutions to support Google's infrastructure growth. You'll work with specific project teams on negotiating agreements, managing vendor and partner relationships and presenting agreement recommendations to our Tech leadership. Your successful negotiations have the potential to save Google millions of dollars in operating costs and impact every part of the business.

As a Data Center Strategic Negotiator, you will combine your real estate development knowledge with tech industry savvy to ensure we have a healthy portfolio of sites ready for development to support Google's growth. You will work with specific project teams on site development, delivering off-site utility infrastructure, managing relationships with local officials, utilities, and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ’s), and presenting portfolio recommendations to our tech leadership.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Work with internal and external Technical teams to identify, define, and pursue site selection projects and initiatives necessary to meet Google ongoing data center needs.
  • Lead data center site evaluations and selection process, monitor progress against objectives, provide regular status reports, and financial metrics to support portfolio decisions.
  • Lead the acquisition of appropriate data centers and develop strategic agreements with vendors, landowners, and key suppliers for space and utility services.
  • Manage the strategy for ongoing growth at existing sites and develop metrics for the mapping and tracking of portfolio management issues regarding site/infrastructure development.
  • Foster an open workplace for colleagues in day-to-day interactions and conversations.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Public Policy, Finance, Real Estate, Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience negotiating and structuring agreements or leading business development for data center capacity, site selection or acquisition.
  • Experience in collocation agreements, site selection for industrial projects, real estate evaluation, acquisition, development, construction, utility agreements negotiation, implementing clean energy initiatives, or financial modeling
  • Experience managing projects and timelines within the Asia Pacific region.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in real estate development, evaluation, acquisition, construction, and site selection for industrial-scale projects.
  • Experience with power transmission and distribution, telecommunications infrastructure, data center technology, industrial-class electrical and cooling technology, or other related technical areas.
  • Experience in indirect taxes, economic development policy, infrastructure development, agreement drafting, presentation development, and data center real estate markets.
  • Experience managing utility agreements and energy-related issues, and financial modeling and implementing clean energy initiatives.
  • Ability to think outside the box and propose commercially and technically creative solutions.
  • Ability to comfortably work in ambiguous, collaborative, and fast-paced environments.

title: Product Manager, Google Drive — Next Billion Agents (Agent Platform and Governance)
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google Drive crossed a billion human users; our next billion users will be AI agents. We are on a mission to transition Drive from a static repository of files into an active execution partner and the context, storage, and governance bedrock of the agent era.

On the Next Billion Agents pillar, we treat first-party and third-party agents as first-class users while keeping humans safely in control. As work shifts from single documents to multi-file trees and parallel agentic workflows, our team builds the foundational rails that let humans and agents collaborate at machine speed: Drive’s model context protocol platform and semantic retrieval, multiplayer agent attribution and comment collaboration, least-privilege folder sandboxing, agent skills and project extensibility, and rich HTML/Markdown artifact experiences.

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products— Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Drive Agent Performance and Interop primitives—including Drive’s Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, semantic passage retrieval, event subscriptions, unshared agent scratch storage, and native support for emergent primitives like Skills and Workspace Projects.
  • Lead Agent Governance, Trust and Safety capabilities—including clear write-time agent attribution across drive and editors, least-privilege folder scoping (Label-Based OAuth/App Access Tags), actor-based DLP, human-in-the-loop (HITL) approvals, and multi-file agent undo/version control.
  • Deliver First-Class Agent Artifacts and Multiplayer UX—enabling humans and agents to coordinate in comments and view, critique, and promote agent-generated Markdown, HTML, and multi-file outputs into shared workflows.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, UX, Data Science, Security, and cross-Workspace partner teams (Gemini Enterprise, Documents/Editors, Cloud/Platform) to grow weekly active agents (WAAs) and governed agent file activity.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
  • 3 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
  • Experience developing or launching products or technologies within artificial intelligence or machine learning (AI/ML).
  • Experience building developer platforms, APIs/SDKs, agentic protocols (e.g., Model Context Protocol (MCP)), or cloud storage/file-system primitives.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
  • 5 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
  • 4 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to executive leadership.
  • Familiarity with LLM agent architectures, context/RAG retrieval, or enterprise security, identity, OAuth scoping, and data governance (Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Access Control Lists (ACLs)).
  • Track record of shipping 0-to-1 platform capabilities that bridge technical infrastructure and intuitive end-user/admin controls across complex cross-functional organizations.

title: Staff Mechanical Engineer, Debug
descriptionHtml:
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will join a small, close-knit team of mosquito biologists, software engineers, and automation experts working to develop better ways to reduce the impact of mosquito-borne diseases. Responsible for Research and Development across various processes and products, you will be central to the design, development, deployment, and ongoing improvements of Debug technology and products.

You will have a wide breadth of mechanical engineering skills and experience, and will flourish in changing environments while collaborating across teams.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build automated systems with a wide variety of electromechanical components, including servo systems, pneumatics, sensors, drive components, etc.
  • Oversee the full product lifecycle, from defining requirements and prototype validation to the final launch of production-ready systems.
  • Act as a primary technical point-of-contact to science, software, and operations teams to resolve foundational engineering issues requiring unique and creative solutions.
  • Design and iterate collaboratively with real-world users and use cases. Test prototypes and released products to verify compliance to design specifications. Investigate and resolve technical problems involving product performance in production equipment.
  • Determine and establish product performance through engineering calculations and layouts; use appropriate engineering tools such as Computer-Aided Design (CAD), Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and Design for Automation (DFA).

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience designing and testing electro-mechanical, pneumatic and fluid systems.
  • Experience using prototyping tools and techniques.
  • Experience designing industrial or lab automated systems.
  • Experience with modeling CAD software such as SolidWorks.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience growing and managing high performance hardware teams.
  • Experience with agreement manufacturers and vendor management, as well as cost and strategy.
  • Experience improving prototypes and systems iteratively and a demonstrated interest in working through the full development lifecycle.
  • Experience managing technical initiatives from concept to full scale.
  • Experience with engaging in building, testing, and breaking of prototypes and systems, with the ability to work on multiple projects in a changing environment.
  • Knowledge of robotics/automated systems, industrial pneumatics and sensors, biotech equipment and applicable standards.

title: Partner Forward Deployed Engineering Manager III, GenAI, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
As a Manager of a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within partners for our customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke and scalable agentic solutions directly with our partners, for and within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic partners, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical connector and feedback loop for the partner to Google, transforming real-world field and partner insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap. You will serve as the agent engineer bridging the gap between AI prototypes and production-grade reality for our strategic AI partners and their own FDE teams.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a team lead and developer within the Google Cloud partner FDE organization to drive the transition from rapid prototypes to production-grade, replicable agentic workflows (multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure partner developed agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Identify repeatable partner and field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
  • Co-build with a strategic AI partner’s own Forward Deployed Engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.
  • Help partners to build their own agentic delivery capabilities to set them up for long-term success, focusing on the ROI at customer engagements ensuring customer activation.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in cloud computing or a technical customer-facing role.
  • 2 years of experience managing a software engineering, forward deployed engineering, or a similar technical customer-facing team in a cloud computing environment.
  • Experience developing AI/Generative AI (GenAI) solutions utilizing AI tools and designing multi-agent workflows and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Expertise in designing intuitive interfaces for complex AI and agentic systems, prioritizing context engineering, transparency, and explainability to foster user trust.
  • Ability to design end-to-end secure, observable multi-agent systems using complex design patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection), state management, and tool-calling protocols.
  • Ability to perform deep discovery interviews to find the true business problem and translate complex hardware/AI constraints for C-suites and deep-technical teams.
  • Background in architecting AI solutions within complex infrastructures, ensuring data sovereignty and secure governance.

title: Account Manager Associate, Large Customer Sales (English)
descriptionHtml:
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

As an Account Manager Associate, you will be part of the Google Americas sales associate program. Through this program, Google develops sales associates in specific product and business training and executive access/exposure over a fixed period of time. You will move across different Google advertising sales teams and roles, serving as media account managers for short-term assignments to help cover team member extended leaves. Upon completion of the program, you will transition into permanent account manager roles or other positions at Google. You will work in a team-focused environment, managing relationships with clients, and work with your manager to find a permanent role post program.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $75000 - $105000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Take responsibility for the account management of clients on sales team.
  • Craft and deliver solutions to customers to achieve their business objectives and drive business growth for Google, with some guidance.
  • Partner with customers and help drive customer relationships in order to work towards mutual business objectives. Contribute to building, growing, and maintaining customer portfolios to drive high-impact, long-lasting relationships.
  • Provide campaign updates, troubleshoot client challenges, and deliver customer training in all Google tools.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in sales, digital marketing, or digital advertising through full time roles, internships, or relevant coursework.
  • Ability to communicate in English fluently in order to interact in this customer-facing sales role.
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of the time for client meetings and training, as required.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience working with Google Ads, managing advertising and media campaigns.
  • Ability to work towards strategic goals in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent client service, relationship building, organizational, investigative, problem-solving, and influencing skills.

title: Software Engineering Manager, GCE Node, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

We are seeking an experienced software engineering manager to build and lead a high-performance computing organization in India. This is a critical role that will contribute to enabling Compute/AI/ML/HPC workloads for our customers. In this role, you will communicate with multiple teams in various geographic locations to develop this expertise and deliver this time-to-market-sensitive program.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Scale the team to develop the world's most performant and reliable compute and AI infra.
  • Provide long-term vision to build VM performance to provide high computing VM families. Own end to end responsibility of enabling the technology to deliver these cutting edge VM families, ensuring their availability, reliability, and performance.
  • Grow the team to expand new capabilities that extend beyond the immediate project. 
  • Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams. Evolve the technical roadmap to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs.
  • Design, guide and vet systems designs within the scope of the broader area to solve ambiguous problems. Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).
  • 3 years of experience in technical leadership role; overseeing projects.
  • 3 years of experience in a people management, supervision/team leadership role.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
  • Experience in Kernel programming, Kernel drivers, virtual machines, virtualization, software architecture, storage.

title: BI Tech Lead, Data products, YouTube
descriptionHtml:
As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for the technical relationship of our largest advertising clients and/or product partners. You will lead cross-functional teams in Engineering, Sales and Product Management to leverage emerging technologies for our external clients/partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships.

You will be able to balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative, cutting edge solutions and act as a partner and consultant to those you are working with. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.

Biz Data and Analytics (BIZ D&A) drives robust business decisions through expert analysis, data democratization, and actionable insights. The Users, Partnerships, and Creators Data Products team enhances the experience of front-line strategic partner managers and support operations. This is achieved by developing scalable data products and delivering cogent insights for partner engagement, creator and consumer support, and go-to-market strategies across YouTube's various relationships with creators, brands, media companies, and distributors.

In this role, you will lead the development of our centralized reporting and analytics solutions. You will partner with Partnerships, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to translate business needs into data products, driving better decision-making at scale. You will own the delivery of these solutions while advocating technical best practices among the community of business intelligence (BI) analysts and data engineers.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Preferred qualifications:

title: AI Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:

title: Product Manager I
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Join the Ads Data Management team as a Product Manager and help shape the future of privacy-centric advertising. Our team is behind impactful products like Google Tag Gateway, Data Manager, and Confidential Compute. In this role, you will drive innovation in how advertisers ingest, manage, and activate their first-party data across Google's advertising platforms. You will handle ambiguous problems, develop long-term product strategies, and influence stakeholders across the organization. You will be passionate about data, understand the advertising technology ecosystem, and grow in a fast-paced environment. This is an opportunity to have a significant impact on the success of countless advertisers globally.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $138000 - $197000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Drive innovation in how advertisers ingest, manage, and activate their first-party data across Google's ad platforms.
  • Leverage new and existing types of privacy-preserving techniques and define the outlook for how conversion measurement evolves given ecosystem, regulatory, and industry changes.
  • Ideate and apply advanced ML/modeling techniques to deliver measurement breadth and accuracy for advertisers in a data-constrained environment.
  • Enable customers to bring and make sense of first party data from disparate sources such as CDPs, CRMs, databases, cloud stores and more.
  • Collaborate with Google Ads Advertiser, Google Analytics and Enterprise Platforms teams to bring your outlook and solutions to life in the Google Ads UI.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
  • 1 year of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
  • Experience managing Ad tech products.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
  • 2 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to executive leadership.
  • 2 years of experience working cross-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders.
  • Experience with API development and management.

title: Account Executive, Mid-Market Sales, Google Customer Solutions (English, Japanese)
descriptionHtml:
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow. Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.

Responsibilities

  • Establish a partnership with executives and serve as a trusted consultant with an understanding of industry insights and solutions, optimizing and expanding their advertising investment.
  • Manage a group of businesses by understanding what promotes growth, identify opportunities for growth, managing risks, and create multi-quarter plans for growth.
  • Prioritize and deliver quality customer experience to Google's advertisers.
  • Coach teammates in the organization to expand skills that cultivate customers growth and contribute to team success.
  • Generate plans by collaborating with specialists, engineers, and product teams, and define business goals, strategies, and metrics for success.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with working in advertising business, marketing, consulting, media or working with advertising agencies or 3 years of experience with an advanced degree.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Japanese fluently to interact in this customer-facing role.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in managing a portfolio in an advertising or media sales context with the ability to achieve quotas to promote growth.
  • Experience in working with advertisers, agencies, or clients and collaborating with C-level stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of traditional and online marketing strategy and tactics across all digital advertising products.
  • Ability to assess and solve client needs by business techniques, including questioning, managing issues and engaging promotions.
  • Ability to build narratives and utilize storytelling as a client engagement strategy.
  • Excellent leadership skills and executive functioning within the digital marketing space.

title: Data Cloud Sales Specialist
descriptionHtml:

As an Agentic Data Cloud Sales Specialist, you will be at the forefront of driving Google Cloud's most critical data and AI growth. You will secure net-new greenfield logos and identify untapped, uncommitted workloads. You will partner with Field Sales Representatives, Customer Engineers, and Partners to execute joint Data+AI plays that establish long-term data platform standardization. You are a master of value-selling. You will engage with line-of-business (LoB) leaders, CDO, CAIO, and CFO to discover critical pain points, build robust business cases (ROI/TCO reduction), and demonstrate the quantifiable business value of modernizing data estates on GCP.


Additionally, you will guide technical stakeholders and position Google Cloud's Agentic Data Cloud suite (BigQuery, Knowledge Catalog, Borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB) as the premium data intelligence platform for AI. You will present demos that showcase how unified, well-governed data foundations power secure, hallucination-free AI agents and real-time experiences.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver against quota and achieve or exceed strategic business and growth goals. Drive net-new greenfield logos and workloads in existing accounts through proactive campaigns.
  • Run complex, multi-threaded business cycles from initial discovery and value hypothesis to ROI business case creation and commercial close.
  • Engage line of business leaders, Chief Data Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Marketing Officer, Chief AI Officer, through value-selling, tying modern data and AI capabilities to quantified business outcomes.
  • Align cross-functionally with FSRs and partners to execute joint Data+AI plays, driving platform standardization and co-sell motions.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in quota-carrying enterprise sales.
  • Experience building business cases through workshops or product demos to business executives.
  • Experience developing partnerships with technical stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists).
  • Experience positioning and selling technical solutions in data management, analytics, infrastructure, or AI/ML.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience positioning modern cloud data platforms, lakehouses, real-time streaming, or GenAI platforms against legacy or other proprietary enterprise systems.
  • Experience closing large-scale data and AI transformation agreements within specific regulated or high-growth enterprise verticals (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing).
  • Experience working with Global System Integrators, hyperscalers, or ISVs to co-sell and accelerate pipeline.
  • Practical understanding of how modern cloud architectures, data governance (e.g., cataloging, lineage, compliance), and clean data estates enable AI and real-time analytics.

title: Enterprise Account Manager, Life Sciences, Google Cloud UKI
descriptionHtml:
The Google Cloud Life Sciences & Industrials team is where a unique convergence of strategic investment, technological differentiation and proven market success combine to serve our growing diversified customers.

Minimum qualifications:

title: Land Development Manager III, Data Centers
descriptionHtml:
Google's infrastructure needs go far beyond server computers. As Google's products and services scale the globe, the Strategic Negotiation team works behind the scenes to secure infrastructure for Google's future -- everything from underwater cables to physical data center space. As a Strategic Negotiator, you combine your deep market knowledge of a given sector with tech industry savvy to negotiate cost-effective solutions to support Google's infrastructure growth. You'll work with specific project teams on negotiating deals, managing vendor and partner relationships and presenting deal recommendations to our Tech leadership. Your successful negotiations have the potential to save Google millions of dollars in operating costs and impact every part of the business.

Within Infrastructure Construction and Asset Management (ICAM), the Data Center Land Development team stewards Google’s owned Data Centers and supporting infrastructure post-acquisition. We bridge the gap between raw land and construction, ensuring on-time capacity delivery by mitigating risk, securing complex land entitlements, and negotiating utility agreements to build a scalable real estate foundation.

As a Land Development and Portfolio Manager, you will partner with cross-functional teams to lead pre-construction development on owned sites. You will take ownership of land-use entitlements, finalize provider agreements, and coordinate off-site infrastructure to ensure sites operate on schedule, within budget, and at full capacity. Serving as the primary site lead from post-acquisition through asset end-of-life, you will cultivate vital relationships with local jurisdictions, utility partners, and engineering teams to drive long-term operational success.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $150000 - $217000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Negotiate utility infrastructure and extension agreements (water, wastewater, gas, power, roads) with providers and AHJs. Ensure third-party and company-delivered extensions are timely, cost-effective, and secured with firm capacity and protective terms.
  • Support civil, utility, and building construction programs by ensuring campuses are development ready and aligned with schedules. Coordinate zoning, entitlements, easement actions, environmental mitigations, permitting (air, discharge), and grid or traffic impact studies.
  • Serve as the lead liaison with local and national utility providers for supply strategy. Facilitate critical negotiations between internal technical teams and external partners to secure the utility capacity needed for planned data center developments.
  • Manage all development activities to consistently meet or exceed required infrastructure delivery schedules as determined and communicated by internal capacity planning teams.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Urban Planning, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Real Estate, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience leading negotiations on land entitlements and infrastructure agreements on projects using a combination of internal and external resources.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Urban Planning, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Real Estate, or a related field.
  • Experience managing greenfield land development, site selection, and real estate transactions for large-scale data centers or mission-critical facilities.
  • Experience in agreement drafting, redlining, and delivering presentations.
  • Expertise in project economics, risk management, financial modeling, budgeting, indirect taxes, and economic development policy.
  • Track record of collaborating with utility providers and local governments to secure power allocations, with an understanding of power transmission and data center technology.

title: Cyber Security and Applied AI Engineering Analyst, Chrome Platform Security
descriptionHtml:
Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

Trust and Safety has the critical responsibility of protecting Google's users by ensuring online safety fighting fraud and abuse across Google products. We collaborate with anti-abuse teams across the company to identify and resolve the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. More specifically, in the Trust and Safety Chrome Web Store and Extensions Security team, we are responsible for protecting users from harmful extensions, while enabling developers to provide useful and safe experiences in Chrome.

As a Security and Applied AI Engineering Analyst, you will apply large-scale data analysis to protect Chrome users from abuse, discover and interpret attack vectors and leverage AI to build scaled protections to keep users safe. You will collaborate closely with Engineering and Product partners to identify threats, mitigate risks, and launch new protection mechanisms.
