Sứ mệnh của Google là sắp xếp thông tin của thế giới và giúp thông tin đó trở nên hữu ích và dễ tiếp cận trên toàn cầu. Nhóm thiết bị và dịch vụ của chúng tôi kết hợp những điểm ưu việt nhất trong công nghệ AI, phần mềm và phần cứng của Google để tạo ra những trải nghiệm hữu ích vượt trội cho người dùng. Chúng tôi nghiên cứu, thiết kế và phát triển các công nghệ và phần cứng mới để mang đến cho người dùng trải nghiệm điện toán nhanh hơn, liền mạch hơn và mạnh mẽ hơn. Dù là tìm ra những cách mới để ghi lại và nhận biết thế giới xung quanh, cải tiến kiểu dáng thiết bị hay đổi mới cách thức tương tác, Nhóm thiết bị và dịch vụ đều hướng đến mục tiêu cải thiện cuộc sống của mọi người bằng công nghệ.

Responsibilities

  • Diễn dịch các mục tiêu về độ tin cậy trong quy trình quản lý sản phẩm thành những mục tiêu phù hợp và có thể kiểm thử.
  • Thực hiện quy trình phân tích dữ liệu thống kê, kiểm tra tuổi thọ cấp tốc (ALT) và lập mô hình, cũng như đánh giá rủi ro.
  • Duy trì những mối quan hệ quan trọng với các đối tác là nhà sản xuất theo hợp đồng (CM), phòng thử nghiệm và nhóm nội bộ. 
  • Thúc đẩy quy trình phân tích lỗi đối với mọi lỗi phát hiện được trong quá trình kiểm thử độ tin cậy, dẫn dắt các phòng ban liên ngành nội bộ và bên ngoài để điều hành quy trình này.
  • Phát triển và triển khai kế hoạch kiểm thử, lên kế hoạch và quản lý nguồn lực (ví dụ: nguồn lực và trang thiết bị nội bộ cũng như bên ngoài), đồng thời tổng hợp và trình bày báo cáo. Quản lý độ tin cậy của sản phẩm từ giai đoạn làm nguyên mẫu cho đến hết vòng đời.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân ngành kỹ thuật phần cứng hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển sản phẩm phần cứng tiêu dùng.
  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm kiểm thử sản phẩm phần cứng.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm vận dụng các kỹ thuật thiết kế đảm bảo độ tin cậy.
  • Có kiến thức về các tiêu chuẩn kiểm thử trong ngành (JEDEC, ASTM, IEEE).
  • Có kỹ năng phân tích và tổ chức xuất sắc, tỉ mỉ đến từng chi tiết, có năng lực và cam kết hoàn thành công việc đúng tiến độ với độ chính xác cao.
  • Có kỹ năng giao tiếp hiệu quả và thái độ sẵn sàng hành động.
  • Là một kỹ sư tỉ mỉ, có khả năng giải quyết vấn đề xuất sắc.

title: Game Designer, Inception, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
DeepMind has long-established connections with gaming, whether through early AI-breakthroughs mastering Atari games or Starcraft, and more recent research with Genie and SIMA agents. We are looking for a Game Designer with a deep understanding of core, player psychology, and interactive storytelling to help us architect a new generation of breakthrough experiences. If you are a systems-thinker who views AI not just as technology, but as a brand-new design material, we want you on the team.

Inception runs like a startup, balancing high energy idea generation with pragmatic, clear and regularly refined operations. This collaborative, multidisciplinary group is situated primarily in London and Mountain View with collaborators across the globe. It has a sizable and different portfolio of early stage, design focused projects, with a focus on breakthrough experiences that wouldn’t be possible without AI.

Your mission is to design core loops, mechanics, and gameplay systems that would be fundamentally impossible without AI. You will be the creative glue bridging the gap between machine learning research and player-facing fun.

As a Game Designer, you will advocate a show, don't tell culture by translating abstract AI capabilities into tangible game prototypes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to define player agency, map out system dynamics, and steer creative ideation sessions that push the boundaries of modern game design.Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Responsibilities

  • Inspire others with strong creative that meets the constraints of a brief.
  • Build, playtest, and iterate on interactive proofs-of-concept, leveraging both traditional game engines and generative AI systems.
  • Work closely with a cross-functional team of researchers, engineers, and designers to find creative solutions and achieve project goals.
  • Lead design workshops and brainstorming sessions to uncover novel applications for AI across a various range of genres, from sandbox simulation to emergent narratives.
  • Translate high-level AI capabilities into elegant game mechanics, intuitive player loops, and compelling interactive systems.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in game design, including one or more shipped commercial titles.
  • Experience architecting agentic workflows and implementing generative AI models within a game production or software development pipeline.
  • Experience managing experimental design projects or research and development initiatives.
  • Experience with UI/UX systems or mechanics that focus on player accessibility and cognitive load management.
  • Experience prototyping using industry-standard engines (e.g., Unity, Unreal) or scripting languages (e.g., C#, Python).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience developing games on multiple platforms (e.g., Unity, Godot, Unreal or similar).
  • Experience in Quality Assurance (QA).
  • Experience in UI/UX design.
  • Ability to learn new skills and adapt to changing technology and new opportunities.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with excellent communication skills and ability to work across multiple teams, and be a team player.

title: Software Engineer III, Full Stack
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise, you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Write product or system development code.
  • Participate in, or lead, design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
  • Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
  • Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
  • Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience programming in C++, Python, or Java.
  • 2 years of experience programming in JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • 2 years of experience with front-end frameworks, full-stack development, or API development.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
  • 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms in either an academic or industry setting.
  • 2 years of experience with performance, large-scale systems data analysis, visualization tools, or debugging.
  • Experience developing accessible technologies.
  • Proficiency in code and system health, diagnosis and resolution, and software test engineering.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data and Infrastructure, Professional Intelligence, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
At DeepMind our mission is to build the world's first general-purpose learning agent. Central to this mission is the complex task of measuring the intelligence of our prototypes. As a Software Engineer, you will be working with the AI agents developed by our exceptional team of Machine Learning and Neuroscience research scientists. Your responsibilities will include everything from creating systems for agent testing using 2D and 3D games to developing test problems within physics simulators. You will create graphical visualization of results, build competitive agent leaderboards and test new algorithms on robots. To succeed in this role you will need to have a strong foundation in software engineering and enjoy working on a wide range of challenging problems within a mission-driven team.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Act like an owner ask questions, propose solutions, build consensus, and drive execution from concept to delivery.
  • Build agent capabilities design and implement skills, plugins and typed tools for LLM agents that search, read, reason over and cite large private corporate.
  • Engineer for production an intense focus on code and product quality, testing, CI/CD, monitoring and on-call. Keep live systems healthy while the next generation is built.
  • Implement fine-grained, per-document access controls across search indexes, databases and storage, and make sure every access is logged.
  • Multiply your impact with AI: use the latest AI coding agents to move fast, and help the team do the same.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experince in Python with modern toolchains and frameworks (e.g., uv, ruff, FastAPI, Pydantic).
  • Experience building and operating data pipelines (e.g., one or more of Apache Beam, Dataflow, Flink, and Spark), and with trade-offs between batch and streaming designs.
  • Experience with data storage solutions (e.g., SQL/Postgres, NoSQL, blob storage, search indexes, vector databases) and the trade-offs between them.
  • Experience using coding agents to develop code and tests to specification.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform) and serverless or container platforms (e.g., Cloud Run, GKE).
  • Experience implementing access control and security in data systems (e.g., row-level security, IAM, VPC Service Controls), or working with sensitive or regulated data.
  • Experience with document processing at scale (e.g., OCR, PDF/Office rendering, e-discovery or load-file formats).
  • Experience in start-up-like environments where priorities can change quickly, and joy in learning new technologies and teaching teammates.
  • Exposure to production systems that rely heavily on ML models, including batch inference with large language models.

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
As a Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production-grade reality within customer environments. You will function as a builder-consultant, moving beyond architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions. You will solve the integration complexities, data readiness, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. You will serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment and acting as a critical feedback loop for Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the discovery-to-deployment journey, serving as the lead developer for AI applications and transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems and MCP servers) that drive measurable return on investment.
  • Bridge the enterprise gap by architecting and coding the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters.
  • Engineer for production excellence, building high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet the requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Act as a product catalyst, identifying repeatable field patterns and technical friction points in Google’s AI stack and converting them into reusable modules or product feature requests for engineering teams.
  • Drive regional leadership and upskilling by mentoring talent, co-building with customer teams, and influencing cross-functional strategies to uplevel organizational technical capabilities.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience shipping production-grade AI solutions to external or internal customers.
  • Experience building full-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.
  • Experience in Python.
  • Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, or Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and patterns like ReAct, self-reflection, and hierarchical delegation.
  • Knowledge of large language model-native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.
  • Ability to implement secure agentic workflows incorporating Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool-calling, and OAuth-based authentication.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. title: Data Center Site Negotiator, Acquisition and Development
descriptionHtml:
As Google's products and services grow to serve our billions of users, the Strategic Negotiation team works behind the scenes to secure infrastructure for Google's future. It's a big job that involves everything from operating underwater cables to finding data center space. In this role you combine your deep market knowledge with tech industry savvy to find solutions that support Google's growth. You'll work with specific teams to oversee vendor and partner relationships. Your successful management skills have the potential to impact every part of the business and save Google millions of dollars in operating costs. You'll ensure that we receive contract compliance on our third-party agreements, while identifying the most cost-effective solutions for our needs. You'll take lead on special projects, manage vendors and present your recommendations to Google leadership.

As a Data Center Site Negotiator, you will work with the team to identify locations and sites of interest for Google's data centers, establish agreements and build relationships with landowners, economic development officials, power grid and energy companies, telecommunications companies and government officials, data center developers, as well as data center providers. You will lead discussions for purchase and service agreements with these key stakeholders such as managing a broad range of compliance issues, site/infrastructure development strategy and milestone tracking.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $150000 - $217000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Work with internal and external technical teams to identify, define, and pursue initiatives necessary to meet Google's ongoing data center needs, including agreement of necessary utility connections (e.g., power, water, etc.) at existing and new green and/or brownfield sites.
  • Monitor progress against objectives, providing regular status reports and advocating financial metrics to support both site and infrastructure related portfolio decisions.
  • Manage the strategy for ongoing growth at existing regions and sites.
  • Develop metrics for mapping, tracking, and advocating of a broad range of portfolio management issues regarding site/infrastructure development.
  • Foster an open workplace for colleagues in day-to-day interactions and conversations.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience negotiating and structuring agreements or leading business development.
  • 6 years of experience in real estate development, evaluation, acquisition, construction, and site selection for industrial data center projects.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in real estate development, evaluation, acquisition, construction, and site selection for industrial-scale projects.
  • Experience with power transmission and distribution, telecommunications infrastructure, data center technology, industrial-class electrical and cooling technology, or other related technical areas.
  • Experience managing utility agreements, energy-related issues, financial modeling and implementing clean energy initiatives.
  • Experience in indirect taxes, economic development policy, infrastructure development, agreement drafting, presentation development, and data center real estate markets.
  • Ability to think outside the box and propose commercially and technically creative solutions.
  • Ability to comfortably work in ambiguous, collaborative, and fast-paced environments.

title: Payroll Operations Specialist (Portuguese, English)
descriptionHtml:
Financial Analysts ensure that Google makes sound financial decisions. As a Financial Analyst, your work, whether it's modeling business scenarios or tracking performance metrics, is used by our leaders to make strategic company decisions. While working on multiple projects at a time, you are focused on the details while finding creative ways to solve big picture challenges.

As a Payroll Operations Specialist, you will help execute a operations, drive continuous improvement and automation efforts through tight collaboration with other regional and global Payroll leaders, as well as Human Resources, Taxes, Accounting, Treasury, and Engineering teams.

In this role, you will handle different cultures, processes, and regulations in a region with 6 countries and 8 entities today, while operating with a strong sense of teamwork, cross-functional collaboration, and focus on internal and external customer.The name Google came from "googol," a mathematical term for the number 1 followed by 100 zeros. And nobody at Google loves big numbers like the Finance team when providing in depth analysis on all manner of strategic decisions across Google products. From developing forward-thinking analysis to generating management reports to scaling our automated financial processes, the Finance organization is an important partner and advisor to the business.

Responsibilities

  • Lead accurate, on-time payroll execution across Latin America (LATAM) while ensuring full compliance with complex regional regulations and internal controls.
  • Partner with third-party payroll providers to monitor performance against Service-Level Agreements/Key Performance Indicators (SLAs/KPIs), conduct root-cause analyses, and maintain strong operational standards.
  • Execute critical financial controls, including payment variance analysis, compliance reconciliations, audit responses, and system access management to minimize risk.
  • Drive continuous process improvement and automation initiatives to increase operational efficiency and enhance the employee experience.
  • Act as a payroll subject matter expert on cross-functional projects, including new country launches, regulatory changes, and new compensation or benefit programs.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or Operations, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience in payroll, finance operations, tax or risk/compliance principles.
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese and English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with project management, with the ability to give meticulous attention to detail and strong execution capabilities.
  • Experience with project management and meticulous attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate in Spanish fluently to support client relationship management in this region.
  • Strong process operations mindset paired with excellent investigative and problem-solving skills to optimize complex workflows.
  • Proven track record of process improvement or Six Sigma.

title: Physical Hardware Engineering Director
descriptionHtml:
As a Director of Physical Design Engineering, you will set the technical outlook and lead the execution for our next generation of rack to chip physical solutions, and associated toolings required for its physical operations. Operating at the highest levels of technical leadership, you will be the driving force behind the integration of complex robotics, mechanical and thermal management solutions to enable Google’s ASICs, TPUs, GPUs, CPUs, storage, and advanced networking hardware into our Data Center roadmap.

In this role, you will utilize experience developing highly innovative mechanical/thermal solutions for Computing hardware systems, while delivering them at high-velocity with high quality and reliability. You will lead the team on developing a compelling roadmap, mechanical/cooling solutions from chip to boards, boards to racks and racks to data center, anticipating fleet-level challenges before they happen and leading the industry in the ongoing AI hardware physical delivery and enclosure transformation including the use of Robotics automation systems. You will guide cross-functional teams, align external ecosystems and suppliers, and ensure our hardware scales reliably to meet the unrelenting demands of our global infrastructure. You will utilize direct deep technical expertise in physical design, significant management experience, experience delivery of complex projects and products, and ability to understand existing performance, quality, and advanced mechanical solutions manufacturing.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $275000 - $382000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a comprehensive physical hardware roadmap and solutions for Google’s data center hardware spanning ML TPU, GPU, Networking, Server compute, Storage, and any additional computing hardware and supporting solutions for data center.
  • Drive mechanical, cooling, and robotics solutions from early architecture through to volume production and data center deployment. Anticipate, troubleshoot, and mitigate complex, fleet-wide deployment challenges in a high-demand environment.
  • Steer technical engagements and partnerships with suppliers and ecosystem partners  to ensure high-quality, high-yield volume manufacturing.
  • Serve as the ultimate authority on system-level performance, heavily leveraging your deep expertise in managing complex trade-offs.
  • Elevate the engineering standards across the organization. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to senior engineers across hardware, silicon, and data center operations teams.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Physics, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 15 years of experience working in the computing hardware industry.
  • 10 years of experience in technical leadership and engineering management.
  • Experience architecting and shipping hyperscale compute, telecom infrastructure, or high-reliability physical hardware products directly to the data center.

Preferred qualifications:

  • PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Physics, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Knowledge in data center hardware physical development including mechanical design, thermal management, cables/interconnects, backplanes, robotics/automation, advanced packaging, manufacturing processes, and supply chain diversification.
  • Knowledge in mechanical and product design principles.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, resolve complex technical trade-offs, and drive consensus across large, globally distributed engineering organizations.

title: Quản lý Khách hàng Chiến lược, Ứng dụng và Trò chơi, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để phát triển trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn mang trong mình niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng gặt hái được nhiều thành công nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google lẫn khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, tìm hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và dựa vào đó để xây dựng các giải pháp hiệu quả giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu tham vọng nhất. Bạn gặt hái thành công cùng đội ngũ bán hàng, định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo dấu ấn thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Với vai trò là Quản lý Khách hàng Chiến lược, bạn sẽ là một chuyên gia tiếp thị dựa trên hiệu suất, thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng cho khách hàng thuộc lĩnh vực Ứng dụng và Trò chơi. Bạn sẽ đóng vai trò là một cố vấn tăng trưởng, tận dụng các giải pháp sử dụng AI của Google để mang lại kết quả kinh doanh và cải thiện dấu ấn trên toàn cầu của khách hàng. Bạn sẽ tập trung vào việc phát triển và cải thiện các chiến lược toàn phễu để đáp ứng các Chỉ báo hiệu suất chính (KPI) của khách hàng, chẳng hạn như Lợi tức trên chi tiêu quảng cáo (ROAS) và Giá trị vòng đời của khách hàng (LTV).

Bạn sẽ thúc đẩy sự xuất sắc bằng cách chinh phục khách hàng nhờ những giá trị độc đáo và tối đa hóa hiệu quả các giải pháp quảng cáo của chúng tôi. Bạn sẽ không ngừng chứng minh giá trị và làm nổi bật những thành công đã đạt được nhằm khơi dậy đà tăng trưởng trong tương lai cho khách hàng giữa kỷ nguyên AI đang không ngừng biến đổi.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi lớn trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách cung cấp trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google ở mức giá cạnh tranh trên Google Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường, và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên của khối LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh những công nghệ tiên tiến nhất, làm việc với các quản lý cấp cao, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả thực tế, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Trở thành chuyên gia sản phẩm, hợp tác với các giám đốc sản phẩm tại các công ty thuộc ngành Trò chơi để điều chỉnh mức chi tiêu tiếp thị cho phù hợp với mục tiêu kinh doanh.
  • Quản lý hiệu suất chiến dịch và phân bổ ngân sách trên bộ sản phẩm quảng cáo của Google (Ứng dụng, Tìm kiếm, Hiển thị, Video), liên tục cải thiện mức chi tiêu để gia tăng Lợi tức đầu tư (ROI).
  • Tiến hành phân tích hiệu suất (ví dụ: phân bổ, thử nghiệm chiến lược, phân khúc đối tượng) để khám phá thông tin chi tiết và giải quyết các thách thức của khách hàng.
  • Phân tích các tập dữ liệu để xác định những điểm tắc nghẽn về hiệu suất, đồng thời đề xuất các chiến lược giá thầu và khung đo lường (ví dụ: SKAdNetwork, GA4).
  • Cung cấp thông tin và vận động sự ủng hộ cho Google khi trình bày các sản phẩm mới, hiệu suất và kết quả của chiến dịch cho khách hàng và công ty quảng cáo.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm tập trung vào tiếp thị dựa trên hiệu suất, tối ưu hoá truyền thông hoặc chiến lược tiếp thị dựa trên dữ liệu.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp thông thạo bằng cả tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để giao tiếp với các bên liên quan nội bộ và hỗ trợ khách hàng nói tiếng Việt.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Kinh nghiệm sử dụng các công cụ phân tích (ví dụ: Google Analytics 4, mô hình phân bổ tiếp thị, trang tổng quan trực quan hoá dữ liệu và phần mềm bảng tính) cùng với kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề xuất sắc.
  • Kiến thức về các sản phẩm quảng cáo của Google trên Ứng dụng, Video, Mạng Hiển thị và Tìm kiếm.
  • Hiểu biết về hệ sinh thái ứng dụng, bao gồm cả hoạt động tạo doanh thu và thu nạp người dùng dành riêng cho ngành Ứng dụng và trò chơi.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Google Workspace, AI/ML
descriptionHtml:
Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Gmail Trust and Compliance Infrastructure's mission is to build and maintain infrastructure to keep Gmail and Chat data secure, and to enable rapid development of GenAI based features in Gmail, Workspace and across Google.

The team builds services and pipelines that ensure safety, compliance and the processing of all of Gmail data at scale. Gmail is one of the largest consumer products in the world. This large scale brings unique issues for any technology we use. The team builds and maintains batch and incremental processing infrastructure that can reliably process all of Gmail data within tight Service Level Objectives (SLOs), to power key features for our customers.

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products— Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Work on next generation batch processing infrastructure for Gmail in powering new user experiences.
  • Work on Workspace wide convergence projects to bolster security and trust posture across the board.
  • Work on processing and security technologies to shape the secure data consumption for Gmail and overall workspace.
  • Identify and solve full stack issues with in-depth collaboration with core infrastructure teams towards next-generation batch processing and data validation initiatives.
  • Define best practices to measure, monitor and improve data security, compliance for Gmail and chat to meet our trust and compliance requirements.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 5 years of experience leading Machine Learning (ML) design and optimizing ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging, fine tuning).
  • 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products.
  • 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
  • 3 years of experience working in an organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

title: Customer Engineer, Cloud AI, Financial Services, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:

Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Customer Engineer (CE) with a specialty in Cloud AI, Financial Services, you will partner with technical sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as a technical expert responsible for accelerating technical wins and adoption of complex, specialized workloads. You will leverage your expertise in our product areas, in partnership with Platform CEs, to be writing code to developing prototypes, proofs-of-concept, and demos to promote new, highly specialized solutions to customers. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

title: Senior Staff Tech Lead, YouTube Shorts Discovery
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. In this role, you will tech-lead a team of AI/ML software engineers to grow the YouTube Shorts ecosystem by recommending Shorts that are aligned with users’ dynamically changing interests. The YouTube Shorts discovery models are a suite of large-scale AI/ML systems designed to model users’ interests by leveraging Google-wide data sources, understanding Shorts’ content and recommending the right content to the viewers. Designed for multi-task learning across various surfaces, these models are applied to numerous downstream tasks, including retrieval, user action predictions, rich user model generation, and knowledge distillation for training more compact models.

This role specializes in techniques—including LLMs, generative retrieval, and long-sequence modeling—to build foundational models for personalized retrieval and early-stage ranking.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Tech Lead, Full Stack
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Our engineering team develops a multi-layered optimization application to guide long-term infrastructure strategy and asset planning for data centers by balancing trade-offs between land, energy and network costs, along with power availability, network latency, carbon free energy goals, and delivery timelines over a multi-year horizon. The underlying math optimization for supply-demand matching utilizes a combination of evolutionary search algorithms, lexicographic optimization, deterministic multi-step matching heuristics, and mini-max scenario decision theory. Our team also develops tools for Network Demand and Supply Workflows, Energy and Power Forecasting, Agentic Data Lake, Risk management, and Data Analytics. Ours is a high visibility and exponentially growing space. Our optimization products directly inform where Google should make its next-generation data center investments.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Learn more about benefits at Google.

title: Research Scientist, Generative Media and Multimodal LLM
descriptionHtml:
As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

In this role, you will conduct research on multimodal LLM and agentic workflows for generative media. Collaborating closely with visual generation researchers, you will focus primarily on the language and reasoning side of multimodal generation and multi-turn editing—designing and post-training models that understand nuanced user intent, ground generation using search and external tools, evaluate output quality via reward models and automated judges, and generalize across various languages and writing systems.

Google Research is building the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. Google Research teams collaborate closely with other teams across Google, maintaining the flexibility and versatility required to adapt new projects and foci that meet the demands of the world's fast-paced business needs.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct fundamental and applied research on multimodal LLMs and agentic workflows for generative media, including multi-turn reasoning, planning, instruction following, and tool use.
  • Design, prototype, and run experiments on post-training and alignment methods (such as fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and synthetic data curation) to improve model quality, faithfulness, and controllability.
  • Define data pipelines, benchmarks, reward models, and evaluation metrics for multimodal generation and interactive editing under minimal guidance, refining hypotheses through empirical analysis.
  • Identify and investigate research opportunities in multilingual, cross-lingual, and cross-script multimodal modeling, collaborating with internal teams to shape research strategy and expand impact.
  • Author research papers to share findings in the research community, and partner with Engineering teams to transfer promising research into Google products.

Minimum qualifications:

  • PhD in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with research projects in Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), or Multimodal Machine Learning.
  • One of more scientific publication submission(s) for conferences, journals, or public repositories (such as CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

  • 2 years of coding experience.
  • 1 year of experience owning and initiating research agendas.
  • Research experience or publications in LLM agents (planning, reasoning, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation), multimodal vision-language models, multilingual NLP, or post-training and alignment (fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, reward modeling).

title: Senior Security Engineer, Agentic Red Team, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
At Google DeepMind our mission is to build the world's first general-purpose learning agent. Central to this mission is the complex task of measuring the intelligence of our prototypes. As a Software Engineer, you will be working with the cutting edge AI agents developed by our exceptional team of Machine Learning and Neuroscience research scientists. Your responsibilities will include everything from creating systems for agent testing using 2D and 3D games to developing test problems within physics simulators. You will create graphical visualization of results, build competitive agent leaderboards and test new algorithms on robots. To succeed in this role you will need to have a strong foundation in software engineering and enjoy working on a wide range of challenging problems within a mission-driven team.

As a part of the Agentic Red Team, you will be a specialized, high-velocity unit within DeepMind Security. Your mission is to close the Agentic Launch Gap—the critical window where novel AI capabilities outpace traditional security reviews.

As a Senior Security Engineer on the Agentic Red Team, you will be the primary technical executor of adversarial engagements. You will work with product builders, identifying architectural flaws during the design phase long before formal reviews begin.

Your core focus will be to perform multi-turn attacks on production-level AI models, specifically targeting agentic behaviors like tool usage and reasoning chains. You will not only find vulnerabilities but also help close the loop by contributing to Auto Red teaming frameworks and defensive strategies, ensuring that your findings are codified into reusable guardrails for all Google agent developers.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct rapid, security assessments on agentic services, focusing on vulnerabilities unique to Generative AI such as prompt injection, tool-use escalation, and autonomous lateral movement.
  • Engineer and execute attack sequences that exploit non-deterministic model behaviors, agentic logic errors, and data poisoning vectors.
  • Write code to transform manual vulnerability discoveries into automated regression testing frameworks ("Auto Red Teaming") that prevent regression in future model versions.
  • Partner directly with developers during the design and build phases to provide immediate feedback, effectively shortening the feedback loop between offensive findings and defensive engineering.
  • Maintain and expand a library of agent-specific attack patterns and exploit primitives to establish release criteria for new models.

Minimum qualifications:

descriptionHtml:

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Network Delivery Engineering
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

Google's Global Network Infrastructure powers the world's largest compute, storage, and AI/ML workloads, spanning hyperscale data centers, optical networks, subsea cables, and the edge. Network Delivery Engineering is the critical operational bridge between upstream network technology development and downstream global deployment.

As Google's AI/ML and Cloud infrastructure scales, we are fundamentally re-engineering how we deliver networks, transforming our delivery engine from bespoke execution to a high-throughput, predictable production system. Our mission is to re-engineer delivery for throughput.

As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will be the lead architect re-engineering our end-to-end network delivery lifecycle. At the intersection of network engineering, process engineering, and systems thinking, you will treat the entire delivery pipeline, from architectural intent and New Product Introduction (NPI) to material orchestration, automated provisioning, and field turnup, as a single integrated system. You will diagnose bottlenecks, redesign cross-functional workflows, define automation requirements, and standardize engineering standards to unlock step-function gains in delivery velocity, quality, and scale.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

  • Re-architect onboarding for next-generation hardware, optical interconnects, and SDN software, embedding zero-touch automation and testability upstream into design phases (EVT/DVT/PVT).
  • Partner with engineering teams to translate processes into automated workflows and AI-enabled guardrails, while defining metrics and feedback loops to predict delivery risks and drive root-cause elimination.

title: Technical Program Manager II, Design and Delivery, Core
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As a Technical Program Manager in Experience Design and Delivery, you will manage the execution of brand experience installations, modular demo platforms, and facility modernization projects across Google Experience Centers (GECs) and briefing hubs. You will oversee the delivery lifecycle for assigned spaces and content coordinating creative agency production, vendor fabrication schedules, software/hardware testing protocols, and financial tracking. Working in close partnership with Real Estate and Workplace Services (REWS), internal software teams, and external design, technology, and fabrication partners, you will ensure our physical showcase spaces launch on time and on budget.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

title: Real Estate Portfolio Executive, APAC
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Real Estate team, you are a critical thinker with versatile knowledge on the front lines of Google's physical expansion. Google cannot grow without you. You are part of a team with a wide range of responsibilities including lease administration, real estate transaction management, and the design and construction supervision of our next and ever expanding offices. You help manage the spatial requirements for a workforce that is growing at lightning speed to ensure that the job is not only done to Google's high and industry-setting standards, but also in a way that promises long-term sustainability and care for our world's resources.

The Real Estate Solutions (RES) team manages the end-to-end transaction lifecycle of Google’s real estate holdings across APAC (excl. India), creating a single point of accountability for transaction delivery.

Your primary goal is to provide cost-effective and flexible real estate solutions for Google. You will devise and execute a full range of real estate transaction strategies—including acquisitions, dispositions, leasing, developments, and subleases—to optimize portfolio performance, mitigate risk, and maximize economic and operational value.

You will partner with regional and workplace leaders to develop and deliver customized supply-side strategies, leveraging workplace insights to meet business needs. You will operate as a trusted advisor and assemble cross-functional teams of subject matter experts across Legal, Finance, Tax, Development, and Operations to execute transactions according to agreed financial goals and strategic agreements.

  • Assemble and lead cross-functional teams across REWS, Legal, Finance, Tax, and Compliance to ensure transactions are performed according to agreed financial goals and space delivery schedules.

title: Senior Security Developer, Google Threat Intelligence Group
descriptionHtml:

title: Staff Software Engineer, Google Data Center Planning
descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:

title: Lead Analyst, Frontier Safety
descriptionHtml:
Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

The Content Adversarial Red Team (CART) in Trust and Safety conducts adversarial testing of Google’s Generative AI models, product surfaces, and autonomous agents to uncover vulnerabilities, jailbreaks, and emerging catastrophic risks not identified in standard evaluations.

In this Lead Trust and Safety Analyst role, you will serve as the Senior Dual-Domain Frontier Safety (FS) Analytic Expert (CBRN and Cyber) and evaluation lead. Bringing deep subject-matter expertise in Frontier Safety threats, you will design, direct, and conduct complex red-teaming assessments to evaluate high-consequence capability uplift risks across Google's AI products. Operating with high autonomy across multi-quarter strategic horizons, you will anchor CART's Frontier Safety red-teaming program (~70%) while partnering with sibling RAIT teams (SCALE and Novel) (~30%).

In this collaboration, you will calibrate automated product-surface evaluators (autoraters), evolve dynamic attack trees, define threat personas for multi-turn/agentic simulators, and lead Tier-1 product loss triage. At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $171000 - $247000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Design and execute complex red-teaming assessments to identify critical CBRN and cyber capability uplift risks across generative AI products.
  • Partner with Engineering, Research, and Policy teams to translate red-teaming findings into robust product mitigations and safety guardrails.
  • Collaborate with sibling RAIT teams to develop autoraters, dynamic attack trees, and threat personas for agentic simulators.
  • Direct specialized external vendors and subject-matter experts to scale testing and ensure high-signal threat intelligence.
  • Present frontier safety findings, risk assessments, and evaluation frameworks to executive leadership and external stakeholders. Work with sensitive content or situations and may be exposed to graphic, controversial, or upsetting topics or content.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in data analytics, trust and safety, policy, cybersecurity, business strategy, or related fields.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD.
  • Experience in SQL, building dashboards, data collection/transformation and visualization/dashboards.
  • Experience working with Chemical, Biological, Radiological, or Nuclear (CBRN) and Cyber threat risks in GenAI.
  • Experience in a scripting/programming language (e.g., Python) and machine learning.
  • Experience working with engineering and product teams to create tools, solutions, or automation to improve user safety.
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to influence cross-functionally at various levels.

title: Lead Data Center Systems Architect
descriptionHtml:

Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state-of-the-art, environmentally-friendly facilities. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians.

As a Data Center Systems Architect, you will serve as the technical anchor bridging advanced compute hardware roadmaps, facility-level engineering, and construction execution. You will establish the system-level architectures, physical row topologies, and electrical/mechanical boundaries required to deploy next-generation high-density AI/ML clusters and cloud infrastructure at global scale.

In this role, you will guide designs from early-stage conceptual development through schematic layouts and construction documentation. You will partner closely with compute and hardware engineering, thermal/mechanical specialists, facility operations, and external Architectural and Engineering (A&E) partners to transform complex engineering trade-offs into modular, highly scalable, and rapidly deployable infrastructure blueprints.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next-generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Technical Operations Engineer, Controls
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we aim to foster Googley work environments that are collaborative, friendly and fun. The Facilities Management team brings our spaces to life as you oversee the daily operations of our offices. While roles with similar names at other companies can be far more mundane, you're a creative, organized customer service specialist, who takes pride in seeing things run smoothly and efficiently. You go out of your way to make sure that clients are not only satisfied, but singing Google's praises. You're comfortable in a fast-paced environment with the highest standards of excellence. You aren't afraid to have fun with your job, and bring an enthusiasm, dedication and a collaborative spirit to build and maintain office spaces that facilitate some of the world's most cutting edge innovation.

In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for transitioning controls-related projects from technical program managers, taking ownership of their continued development and implementation within the region. You will be responsible for developing, standardizing, and maintaining regional monitoring dashboards and systems, ensuring their ongoing functionality and effectiveness.You will also play a key role in knowledge sharing by leading Controls Office Hours sessions to train the team. You will provide crucial support for Post Mortems, Technical Due Diligence (TDD), Site Operational Readiness Assessments (SORA), and risk analysis as they pertain to the controls and monitoring of Third-Party Data Center (3PDC) sites. You will be identifying and raising deficiency issues with monitoring tools and driving these issues to resolution to improve tool efficacy.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving channel behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €112000 - €114000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact to transition controls-related projects from technical program managers, taking ownership of their continued development and regional implementation.
  • Develop, standardize, and maintain regional monitoring systems and dashboards, proactively identifying and resolving tool deficiencies to optimize overall performance.
  • Lead knowledge-sharing sessions and training initiatives to support and educate the broader team on controls engineering practices.
  • Provide critical support for incident post-mortems, technical due diligence, site operational readiness assessments, and risk analysis for third-party data centers.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 9 years of experience in data center operations, critical facilities management, or facility commissioning.
  • Experience working with mechanical, electrical, or control systems infrastructure.
  • Experience with control system protocols (e.g., Modbus, BACnet, SNMP).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a relevant engineering field.
  • Experience developing and maintaining monitoring dashboards and data visualization tools with a focus on Google-internal tools like Show of Power, DCViz, and Coolrunning.
  • Experience working with industrial control systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS), Power Monitoring Systems (PMS), or SCADA systems.
  • Experience in a third-party data centers (3PDC) or co-location data center environment.
  • Experience participating in Technical Due Diligence (TDD) or Site Operational Readiness Assessments (SORA) with the knowledge of risk assessment methodologies (e.g., FMEA).
  • Excellent scripting or programming skills relevant to data analysis or control system integration.

title: Strategic Partner Development, Payments Platform (English, Japanese)
descriptionHtml:
Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. title: Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, Ngành Trò chơi và Ứng dụng, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (tiếng Anh, tiếng Việt)
locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để tăng trưởng trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn lan toả niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng đạt được thành công lớn nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google và khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, tìm hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và dựa vào đó để xây dựng các giải pháp hiệu quả giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu lớn lao nhất. Bạn gặt hái thành công cùng đội ngũ bán hàng, định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo dấu ấn thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Với vai trò là Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, bạn sẽ là người kiến tạo sự tăng trưởng chiến lược, xây dựng mối quan hệ hợp tác đáng tin cậy với các bên liên quan cấp cao để thống nhất về các mục tiêu kinh doanh đầy tham vọng. Bạn sẽ khai thác sức mạnh của AI tạo sinh và phân tích dự đoán để định hướng những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành, mang lại giá trị độc đáo và tối đa hoá tác động nhằm thúc đẩy sự thành công lâu dài của các đối tác. Ở vai trò này, bạn sẽ vận dụng tư duy nhạy bén trong kinh doanh để xác định, định hướng và thu hút khách hàng bằng các giải pháp Hiệu suất dựa trên AI của Google (Tìm kiếm). Bạn sẽ cung cấp dịch vụ khách hàng, nghiên cứu và phân tích thị trường theo chuẩn của Google, đồng thời dự đoán cách đưa ra quyết định, thấu hiểu những điểm khác biệt tinh vi của từng chiến dịch, cũng như không ngừng tìm tòi và khám phá nhu cầu của các lĩnh vực kinh doanh chủ chốt. Cùng với khách hàng, bạn sẽ đặt ra mục tiêu và chiến lược để quảng cáo của họ có thể tiếp cận người dùng một cách hiệu quả nhất.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách chào bán một cách cạnh tranh trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google trên Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên trong nhóm LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh ở vị trí tiên phong của công nghệ, làm việc với ban điều hành, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả rõ rệt, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Duy trì mối quan hệ bền chặt với khách hàng, công ty quảng cáo và các bên liên quan trọng yếu khác để đảm bảo phù hợp với mục tiêu kinh doanh và thúc đẩy hợp tác thành công.
  • Thiết kế và giới thiệu các giải pháp mang tính đột phá, dựa trên dữ liệu (Tìm kiếm dựa trên AI) phù hợp với nhu cầu của khách hàng. Tận dụng kiến thức chuyên sâu về các giải pháp quảng cáo của Google và kỹ năng kể chuyện lôi cuốn để xử lý hiệu quả các ý kiến trái chiều, thu hút đầu tư và vượt chỉ tiêu doanh thu.
  • Chỉ đạo thực thi các sáng kiến chiến lược để thúc đẩy việc áp dụng và tăng doanh thu cho các giải pháp hiệu suất dựa trên AI (trên Mạng Tìm kiếm), từ đó đổi mới hoạt động quảng cáo của khách hàng.
  • Phân tích và tối ưu hoá Lợi tức đầu tư (ROI) tiếp thị bằng cách theo dõi và đánh giá hiệu suất của các chiến dịch dựa trên AI (trên Mạng Tìm kiếm), đưa ra các đề xuất dựa trên dữ liệu để không ngừng cải thiện.
  • Nắm bắt các xu hướng và cải tiến trong ngành tiếp thị kỹ thuật số, cung cấp thông tin chi tiết và đề xuất chủ động để đảm bảo đội ngũ và khách hàng luôn dẫn đầu trong bối cảnh không ngừng thay đổi.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc có kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 8 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực quảng cáo, tư vấn bán hàng hoặc phát triển kinh doanh.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp lưu loát bằng cả tiếng Việt và tiếng Anh để làm việc với các bên liên quan trong nội bộ và hỗ trợ khách hàng nói tiếng Việt.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Có kinh nghiệm thúc đẩy thay đổi và phối hợp với nhiều bên liên quan.
  • Có kinh nghiệm quản lý dự án liên chức năng.
  • Có kinh nghiệm trong ngành trò chơi.
  • Có kinh nghiệm thiết lập mối quan hệ và bán hàng cho các bên liên quan ở cấp điều hành.
  • Am hiểu về các hoạt động và mô hình kinh doanh truyền thông liên chức năng.
  • Kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề xuất sắc.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Detection and Response Consultant, Cyber Defence, National Security, Mandiant
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Forward Deployed Detection and Response Consultant, Cyber Defence within Mandiant's National Security team, you will embed with clients in Canada's national security and defence sector and directly contribute to building a secure and resilient Canada.

You will provide industry-leading security operations, incident response, assessment, transformation, managed detection and response, and training services with in-depth tactical support. You will help organizations effectively detect and respond to threats and reduce the overall impact of mission risk before, during, and after an incident. You will be able to resolve security incidents quickly, effectively and at scale with complete incident response including investigation, containment, remediation, and crisis management. In this role, you will work on engagements including assisting clients in navigating technically complex and high-profile incidents, developing agentic solutions, performing forensic analysis, threat hunting, and malware triage.

Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Canada: $166000 - $170000 (CAD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with internal and customer teams to detect, respond to, and contain cyber security incidents.
  • Design and build agentic AI solutions to support autonomous detection, response, and remediation.
  • Recognize and codify attacker Tools, Tactics, and Procedures (TTPs) and Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) that can be applied to current and future investigations.
  • Lead and contribute to complex client-facing investigations and examine cloud, endpoint, and network-based sources of evidence.
  • Develop and present comprehensive and accurate reports and presentations for both technical and executive audiences.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in SOC analyst, malware research, threat hunting, or similar roles, working with EDR and SIEM technologies.
  • Experience leading incident response activities.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in security competitions, Capture the Flags (CTFs) or testing platforms such as Hack the Box, TryHackMe, Overthewire, etc.
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, legal counsel, and internal and external clients.
